model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [C-FoS, NeuN, Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** The scientific goal is to map activated neurons (c-Fos) at single-cell resolution in a whole adult mouse brain. iDISCO+ is selected because it is a robust, solvent-based clearing method capable of rendering whole adult brains highly transparent while preserving endogenous fluorescence and allowing deep immunolabeling. The solvent-based approach is faster than many aqueous methods and provides excellent refractive index matching for deep imaging. The labeling strategy combines c-Fos (immediate early gene marker for neuronal activation) and NeuN (mature neuronal marker) to specifically identify and localize activated neurons within the neuronal architecture. Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 are chosen for their brightness and stability in organic solvents.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Rehydration
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.5 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

4 Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5 Blocking
5.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum, 0.02% (wt/vol) Sodium Azide in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

6 Primary Antibody Incubation
6.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution: Rabbit anti-c-Fos (1:1000) and Chicken anti-NeuN (1:1000) diluted in PTw (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS) with 5% Normal Donkey Serum and 0.02% Sodium Azide. (Temperature: RT, Time: 14 days)

7 Wash
7.1 Incubation with PTw (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
7.2 Incubation with PTw (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
7.3 Incubation with PTw (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

8 Secondary Antibody Incubation
8.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) diluted in PTw with 5% Normal Donkey Serum and 0.02% Sodium Azide. (Temperature: RT, Time: 14 days)

9 Wash
9.1 Incubation with PTw (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
9.2 Incubation with PTw (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
9.3 Incubation with PTw (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

10 Dehydration for Clearing
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
10.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

11 Delipidation and Clearing
11.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane in Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

12 Refractive Index Matching
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [c-Fos+Alexa Fluor 488, Npas4+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is highly effective for whole mouse brain clearing, providing excellent transparency and compatibility with immunolabeling for endogenous proteins like c-Fos and Npas4. The methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps preserve fluorescence signals from Alexa Fluor dyes, while the final refractive index matching with dichloromethane/DBE ensures high-resolution imaging. DAPI is included for nuclear counterstaining to aid in single-cell resolution mapping.  

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Fixation and Perfusion  
1.1 Perfuse mouse with 1× PBS followed by 4% PFA in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
1.2 Post-fix brain in 4% PFA in PBS at 4°C with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.3 Wash brain in 1× PBS with 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove excess PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubate brain in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubate brain in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubate brain in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubate brain in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubate brain in 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Repeat 100% methanol incubation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Bleaching  
3.1 Incubate brain in chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes methanol). (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 12 hours)  

4 Rehydration  
4.1 Incubate brain in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubate brain in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubate brain in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubate brain in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubate brain in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Permeabilization  
5.1 Incubate brain in 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBST with 20% (vol/vol) DMSO. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
5.2 Incubate brain in 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBST with 10% (vol/vol) DMSO and 6% (vol/vol) donkey serum. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

6 Immunolabeling  
6.1 Incubate brain with primary antibodies: rabbit anti-c-Fos (1:1000) and goat anti-Npas4 (1:500) in PBST with 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum and 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 7 days)  
6.2 Wash brain in PBST with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution every 8 hours)  
6.3 Incubate brain with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-goat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in PBST with 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum and 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 7 days)  
6.4 Wash brain in PBST with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution every 8 hours)  
6.5 Incubate brain with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Dehydration for Clearing  
7.1 Incubate brain in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.2 Incubate brain in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.3 Incubate brain in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.4 Incubate brain in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.5 Incubate brain in 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.6 Repeat 100% methanol incubation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

8 Delipidation and Clearing  
8.1 Incubate brain in 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)  
8.2 Incubate brain in 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  
8.3 Repeat 100% DCM incubation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  

9 Refractive Index Matching  
9.1 Incubate brain in 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
9.2 Transfer brain to fresh DBE for imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, tdTomato, DAPI]
**Justification:** The simplified CUBIC protocol failed due to insufficient delipidation time and refractive index mismatch for the dense adult mouse brain. uDISCO is selected because it is specifically optimized for whole adult mouse brains, providing rapid and high transparency (RI ~1.51) while preserving endogenous fluorescent proteins like GFP and tdTomato. It uses organic solvents (tert-butanol and dichloromethane) which efficiently remove lipids to solve the turbidity issue and shrink the tissue to improve light penetration for deep imaging. The protocol includes DAPI staining for nuclear counterstaining to aid in cell registration and spatial clustering analysis.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with a series of methanol/water mixtures: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 100% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
1.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol containing 0.3% (vol/vol) hydrogen peroxide for bleaching. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.4 Wash with 100% (vol/vol) methanol twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

2 Delipidation
2.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

3 Nuclear Staining (Optional DAPI)
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-butanol containing 0.001% (wt/vol) DAPI. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching
4.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-butanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.2 Incubation with a mixture of 50% (vol/vol) tert-butanol and 50% (vol/vol) BABB-D (Benzyl Alcohol/Benzyl Benzoate with Diphenyl ether, RI ~1.51). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) BABB-D (RI ~1.51) for final clearing and storage. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours to indefinite)

**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, MBP+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior clearing efficiency on dense, myelinated tissues like the spinal cord and its compatibility with long-distance 3D imaging. The methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation effectively remove lipids that hinder light penetration in the 15 mm spinal segment, which is critical for visualizing deep structures. The protocol is highly compatible with immunolabeling, allowing robust penetration of antibodies against MBP (Myelin Basic Protein) to label the mature axon skeleton and preserved myelin sheaths. This dual-target strategy (GFP for regenerating fibers, MBP-AF647 for mature structure) directly addresses the scientific goal of comparing spatial distributions and mapping regeneration paths relative to the injury core.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Pre-treatment
1.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS at 4°C for 24 hours with gentle shaking.
1.2 Wash with PBS (1x) at RT for 1 hour, repeat 3 times.
1.3 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at RT for 1 hour.
1.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at RT for 1 hour.
1.5 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at RT for 1 hour.
1.6 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at RT for 1 hour.
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol at RT for 1 hour, repeat twice.
1.8 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) at 4°C for 12 hours to bleach autofluorescence.
1.9 Wash with 100% methanol at RT for 1 hour, repeat 3 times.

2 Rehydration and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at RT for 1 hour.
2.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at RT for 1 hour.
2.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at RT for 1 hour.
2.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at RT for 1 hour.
2.5 Wash with PBS (1x) with 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) at RT for 1 hour.
2.6 Incubation with PBS (1x) with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine at 37°C for 24 hours.
2.7 Wash with PBST at RT for 1 hour.
2.8 Incubation with PBS (1x) with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% Donkey Serum at 37°C for 24 hours to block.

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody (Rabbit anti-MBP) diluted in PTwH (PBS with 0.2% Tween-20, 0.01% Heparin, 5% Donkey Serum) at 37°C for 7 days with gentle shaking. (Concentration: 1:500)
3.2 Wash with PTwH at RT for 1 hour, repeat 5 times.
3.3 Incubation with Secondary Antibody (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647) diluted in PTwH at 37°C for 7 days with gentle shaking. (Concentration: 1:500)
3.4 Wash with PTwH at RT for 1 hour, repeat 5 times.

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at RT for 1 hour.
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at RT for 1 hour.
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at RT for 1 hour.
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS at RT for 1 hour.
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol at RT for 1 hour, repeat twice.

5 Delipidation and Clearing
5.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM) at RT for 30 minutes to delipidate, repeat twice.
5.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol at RT for 5 minutes to rehydrate briefly before RI matching.

6 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE (Dibenzyl Ether, Sigma 108014-1KG) without shaking at RT until tissue is transparent (Time: 12-24 hours).

2 Delipidation and Decolorization

3 Refractive Index Matching
3.1 Incubation with BABB-D (Benzyl Alcohol/Benzyl Benzoate with Diphenyl Ether, RI ~1.56). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours until transparent)

**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato, GFP, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO is specifically optimized for large mammalian tissues (like the 35-40mm mouse CNS) and provides superior transparency and shrinkage reduction compared to other solvent-based methods, which is critical for maintaining the spatial relationships of long-range projections. The high refractive index matching solution renders the sample nearly invisible, enabling deep light-sheet microscopy to track fibers from the cortex to the spinal cord terminus.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration

1.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) (first wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) (second wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Delipidation and Decolorization
2.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

3 Refractive Index Matching

**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato, MBP+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** uDISCO is specifically optimized for large, intact mammalian tissues (up to the size of a rat CNS) and provides superior transparency and volume reduction (shrinking), which is critical for imaging the long 35–40 mm mouse CNS axis within a single field of view. The combination of tdTomato (to trace the specific long-range projections) and MBP (Myelin Basic Protein) labeled with Alexa Fluor 647 provides a robust reference signal to visualize white matter tracts, allowing for the assessment of axon routing, branching, and spatial overlap with endogenous networks.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

2 Immunolabeling (Optional/Partial)
2.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS) to enhance antibody penetration. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with blocking solution (6% Donkey Serum, 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.3 Incubation with primary antibody Rabbit anti-MBP (1:500) in labeling solution (3% Donkey Serum, 0.2% Triton X-100, 5% DMSO in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.4 Wash with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS with 3 washes of 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)
2.5 Incubation with secondary antibody Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in labeling solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.6 Wash with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS with 3 washes of 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours total)

3 Re-dehydration for Clearing
3.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
4.1 Incubation with a mixture of 100% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF) and dichloromethane (DCM) (1:1 ratio). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
4.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
4.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) until sample is fully transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12-24 hours)

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) Methanol in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

The use of Alexa Fluor 647 (far-red) minimizes autofluorescence often associated with aged or diseased brain tissue, while DAPI provides a robust nuclear counterstain for anatomical registration of cortical and hippocampal layers.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with PBS (pH 7.4) for 1 hour to wash out residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.7 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to bleach autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.8 Wash twice with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour each to remove H2O2. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.9 Rehydration: Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.10 Rehydration: Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

1.12 Rehydration: Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.13 Rehydration: Incubation with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [6E10+Alexa Fluor 488, Thioflavin S, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior clearing capability on large, dense tissues like the whole mouse brain (10 mm size) and its compatibility with immunolabeling. The methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation effectively remove lipids while preserving protein epitopes for antibody staining. The dual-target strategy using 6E10 (Aβ antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488) and Thioflavin S (chemical dye for amyloid fibrils) provides high specificity and mutual verification to distinguish true amyloid plaques from autofluorescence or artifacts. DAPI is included for nuclear counterstaining to aid in anatomical registration and 3D reconstruction of brain regions.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-Fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 1 hour to wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.7 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to quench autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.8 Wash twice with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour each to remove H2O2. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.9 Rehydration: Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.10 Rehydration: Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.11 Rehydration: Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.12 Rehydration: Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.13 Wash with PBST for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS for 24 hours to permeabilize tissue and reduce background. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 0.2M Glycine in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Wash with 0.2% Tween-20 in PBS (PBT) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

3 Immunolabeling (Primary Antibody)
3.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution: Mouse anti-6E10 (1:500) in PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 0.01% Sodium Azide, 0.1% Heparin in PBS) for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)
3.2 Wash with PBT for 1 day, changing solution at least 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Immunolabeling (Secondary Antibody)
4.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution: Donkey anti-Mouse Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in PTwH for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)
4.2 Wash with PBT for 1 day, changing solution at least 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5 Counterstaining (Thioflavin S and DAPI)
5.1 Incubation with Thioflavin S solution (0.05% w/v in 50% Ethanol/PBS) for 24 hours to stain amyloid fibrils. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.2 Wash with 50% Ethanol/PBS for 6 hours to reduce background staining. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
5.3 Wash with PBT for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
5.4 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/mL in PBS) for 24 hours to stain nuclei. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.5 Wash with PBS for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

6 Dehydration for Clearing
6.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour, repeat twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
6.6 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour to delipidate. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.7 Incubation with fresh Dichloromethane (DCM) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

7 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
7.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) until tissue is transparent (approx. 24 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
7.2 Store and image in 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: >24 hours)

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.7 Wash with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.8 Wash with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.9 Wash with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.10 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (wt/vol) Donkey Serum in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Primary Antibodies: Rabbit anti-Claudin-5 (1:500) and Biotinylated Lycopersicon Esculentum Lectin (1:200) in PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20, 5% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum, and 0.01% (wt/vol) Sodium Azide. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.2 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3 times)

3.5 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.6 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5 Delipidation and Clearing

5.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat twice)
5.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** The CUBIC (Clear, Unobstructed Brain/Body Imaging Cocktails and Computational analysis) method is selected because it is a simple, aqueous-based clearing protocol that offers excellent preservation of endogenous fluorescent proteins (like GFP) and is highly compatible with long-term storage. The problem involves a 3 mm thick tissue block with weak endogenous fluorescence; CUBIC's alkaline amino-alcohol solutions (ScaleA2/CUBIC-1) efficiently decolorize heme and remove lipids while significantly enhancing GFP fluorescence intensity. The use of MAP2 labeled with Alexa Fluor 647 provides a robust, photostable second channel to visualize dendritic structures and local morphology, complementing the weak GFP signal. The final RI matching solution (CUBIC-2) allows for high-resolution 3D imaging and stable storage for re-imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Sample Preparation & Washing
1.1 Rinse the fixed 3 mm mouse brain tissue block in 1x PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Wash the tissue in 1x PBS with 0.1% Triton X-100 to permeabilize the tissue and prepare for staining. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Immunostaining (Dendritic Marker)
2.1 Incubate the tissue in blocking solution containing 5% normal donkey serum and 0.5% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubate with primary antibody against MAP2 (e.g., Chicken anti-MAP2) diluted 1:500 in staining solution (0.5% Triton X-100, 1% donkey serum in PBS). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.3 Wash the tissue in 0.2% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS to remove unbound primary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution every 8 hours)
2.4 Incubate with secondary antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (e.g., Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 647) diluted 1:500 in staining solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.5 Wash the tissue in 0.2% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS to remove unbound secondary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution every 8 hours)

3 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-1)
3.1 Incubate the tissue in CUBIC-1 solution (25 wt% Urea, 25 wt% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in distilled water). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
3.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-1 solution and continue incubation until the tissue becomes transparent. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)

4 Refractive Index Matching and Preservation (CUBIC-2)
4.1 Rinse the tissue briefly in 1x PBS to remove residual CUBIC-1. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
4.2 Incubate the tissue in CUBIC-2 solution (50 wt% Sucrose, 25 wt% Urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in distilled water) for RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)
4.3 Transfer the tissue to fresh CUBIC-2 solution for long-term storage and imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Indefinite)

1 Rehydration

2.3 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.3 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** CUBIC is selected for its superior compatibility with aqueous preservation and excellent fluorescence retention, particularly for weak endogenous signals like GFP, which is crucial for the 6-month storage requirement. The high refractive index (RI ~1.52) of the CUBIC-R solution minimizes scattering in 3 mm thick tissue blocks, allowing for high-resolution 3D imaging. To address the loss of dendritic details and weak signal, the protocol integrates immunolabeling with MAP2 (Alexa Fluor 647) to robustly reconstruct neuronal morphology, complementing the sparse GFP signal. The alkaline amino-alcohol based reagents effectively delipidate tissue while maintaining structural integrity, making it ideal for long-term archiving and repeated imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 100% PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Permeabilization and Decolorization (CUBIC-L)
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% Urea, 25% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
2.2 Wash with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

3 Immunolabeling (Morphology Completion)
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Buffer (5% Donkey Serum, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with Primary Antibody (Anti-MAP2, Chicken, 1:500) in Dilution Buffer (1% Donkey Serum, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
3.3 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change 3 times)
3.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibody (Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500) in Dilution Buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
3.5 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change 3 times)

4 Refractive Index Matching and Long-term Preservation (CUBIC-R)
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45% Sucrose, 30% Urea, 10% 2,2',2''-Nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 days)
4.2 Transfer to fresh CUBIC-R solution for long-term storage and imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 months)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [NeuN+Alexa Fluor 488, MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is specifically optimized for immunolabeling of thick and large tissue samples (like 3 mm human brain slices) by using a methanol dehydration and delipidation series that significantly enhances antibody penetration compared to aqueous methods. **Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

1.6 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.7 Wash with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.8 Wash with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.7 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.8 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20 mg/mL glycine, 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

3.5 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
3.6 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

**Chosen Method:** SeeDB2
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** SeeDB2 is specifically optimized for rapid clearing (within 1 day) while preserving high-quality endogenous fluorescence (GFP) and fine morphological structures like dendritic spines. It uses a simple, non-toxic fructose-based solution that matches the refractive index for high-resolution imaging, making it ideal for 500 μm thick brain slices where speed and structural integrity are critical.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Washing
1.1 Rinse fixed 500 μm brain slices in 1x PBS (pH 7.4) to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.2 Incubate slices in 0.2% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS for permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
1.3 Wash slices in 1x PBS to remove detergent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)

2 Immunostaining (Optional for MAP2)
2.1 Incubate slices in blocking solution (5% normal donkey serum in 0.2% Triton X-100/PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubate with primary antibody against MAP2 (e.g., Rabbit anti-MAP2, 1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 2 hours)
2.3 Wash slices 3 times in 0.1% Triton X-100/PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes per wash)
2.4 Incubate with secondary antibody (e.g., Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)
2.5 Wash slices 3 times in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes per wash)

3 Optical Clearing with SeeDB2
3.1 Incubate slices in SeeDB2 solution A (20 wt% fructose, 0.5% α-thioglycerol in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.2 Incubate slices in SeeDB2 solution B (40 wt% fructose, 0.5% α-thioglycerol in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.3 Incubate slices in SeeDB2 solution C (60 wt% fructose, 0.5% α-thioglycerol in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.4 Incubate slices in SeeDB2 solution D (80 wt% fructose, 0.5% α-thioglycerol in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.5 Incubate slices in SeeDB2 solution E (100 wt% fructose, 0.5% α-thioglycerol in PBS, RI ~1.49). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

4 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
4.1 Transfer cleared slices to fresh SeeDB2 solution E for final RI matching and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
4.2 Store samples in SeeDB2 solution E at 4°C protected from light until imaging (stable for up to 1 week). (Temperature: 4°C, Time: As needed)

**Chosen Method:** SeeDB2
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** SeeDB2 is specifically optimized for rapid clearing (within 1 day) of thin to medium thickness samples (up to 500 μm) while preserving high-resolution fluorescence signals, making it ideal for resolving dendritic spines. It uses fructose-based solutions that are compatible with both endogenous GFP (for sparse neuron labeling) and Alexa Fluor dyes (for MAP2 labeling of the dendritic skeleton). The method maintains tissue morphology and allows for high-resolution imaging without significant quenching or expansion, which is critical for accurate spine counting and dendritic length analysis.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Sample Preparation and Washing
1.1 Rinse fixed 500 μm brain slices in 1x PBS (pH 7.4) to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.2 Incubate with 0.1% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS for permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
1.3 Wash with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)

2 Immunolabeling (Dendritic Skeleton)
2.1 Incubate with blocking solution (5% normal donkey serum, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubate with primary antibody against MAP2 (e.g., Rabbit anti-MAP2, 1:500) diluted in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 4 hours)
2.3 Wash with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS (3 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes total)
2.4 Incubate with secondary antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) diluted in blocking solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.5 Wash with 1x PBS (3 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes total)

3 Optical Clearing (SeeDB2)
3.1 Incubate with 20% (wt/vol) fructose in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.2 Incubate with 40% (wt/vol) fructose in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.3 Incubate with 60% (wt/vol) fructose in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.4 Incubate with 80% (wt/vol) fructose in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.5 Incubate with 100% (wt/vol) fructose in 1x PBS (Refractive Index ~1.49). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.6 Incubate with SeeDB2 solution (47.5% (wt/vol) fructose, 32.5% (wt/vol) sucrose, 20% (wt/vol) urea in water, RI ~1.52). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Mounting and Imaging
4.1 Mount the cleared slice in SeeDB2 solution on a glass slide using a spacer (e.g., 0.5 mm thick) and cover with a coverslip. Seal edges with nail polish. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)
4.2 Image immediately using confocal or two-photon microscopy. (Temperature: RT, Time: N/A)

**Chosen Method:** SeeDB2  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** SeeDB2 is an aqueous-based clearing method optimized for rapid processing (within 1 day) and excellent preservation of fine structures like dendritic spines, addressing the issue of spine blurriness and shrinkage caused by the previous methanol fixation and 100% TDE protocol. The method uses a fructose/glycerol-based refractive index matching solution that minimizes tissue deformation. The labeling strategy combines endogenous GFP for sparse neuronal visualization with MAP2 antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 to enhance dendritic skeleton and spine morphology, ensuring high-resolution 3D imaging and reliable spine counting.  

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Post-Fixation and Washing  
1.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS for 1 hour at RT to stabilize tissue structure. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Wash 3 times with PBS for 10 minutes each to remove excess PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes total)  

2 Immunolabeling (Optional, if MAP2 signal enhancement is needed)  
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution (5% normal goat serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with primary antibody (anti-MAP2, 1:500 in blocking solution) overnight at 4°C. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 12 hours)  
2.3 Wash 3 times with PBS for 10 minutes each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes total)  
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibody (Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated, 1:500 in blocking solution) for 4 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)  
2.5 Wash 3 times with PBS for 10 minutes each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes total)  

3 Optical Clearing with SeeDB2  
3.1 Incubation with SeeDB2 solution A (20% wt/vol fructose, 10% vol/vol glycerol in PBS) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with SeeDB2 solution B (40% wt/vol fructose, 20% vol/vol glycerol in PBS) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with SeeDB2 solution C (80% wt/vol fructose, 20% vol/vol glycerol in PBS, RI = 1.48) for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

4 Refractive Index Matching and Storage  
4.1 Incubation with SeeDB2 solution C (RI = 1.48) for 30 minutes to equilibrate before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Store samples in SeeDB2 solution C at 4°C for up to 1 week. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: Up to 1 week)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Tuj1+Alexa Fluor 488, PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior clearing capability on whole embryos (8–10 mm) and excellent compatibility with immunolabeling, which is crucial for enhancing the signal of early, thin neural projections. The methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation effectively remove lipids while preserving tissue architecture. The dual-labeling strategy using Tuj1 (neuron-specific class III beta-tubulin) and PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal cytoplasmic marker) conjugated to spectrally distinct fluorophores (Alexa Fluor 488 and 647) provides high reliability for tracing neural paths from the CNS to PNS. DAPI is included for nuclear counterstaining to reference anatomical structures. The final RI matching solution (BABB-D or dibenzyl ether) renders the embryo highly transparent for deep light-sheet microscopy.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with 0.2% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 5% (vol/vol) H2O2 in PBS (freshly prepared). (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
2.3 Wash with 0.2% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (3 times). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours per wash)

3 Immunolabeling - Blocking
3.1 Incubation with Permeabilization/Blocking solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 0.3% Glycine, 6% Donkey Serum in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

4 Immunolabeling - Primary Antibody Incubation
4.1 Incubation with Primary Antibodies: Rabbit anti-Tuj1 (1:500) and Rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500) diluted in Antibody Solution (0.2% Tween-20, 3% Donkey Serum, 5% DMSO in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
4.2 Wash with 0.2% Tween-20 in PBS (3 times). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours per wash)

5 Immunolabeling - Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining
5.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) plus DAPI (1 µg/mL) diluted in Antibody Solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
5.2 Wash with 0.2% Tween-20 in PBS (3 times). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours per wash)

6 Dehydration
6.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (2 times). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours per wash)

7 Delipidation
7.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

8 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
8.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [nc82 (Bruchpilot)+Alexa Fluor 488, Synapsin+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** The iDISCO+ method is selected for its superior ability to clear small, chitin-rich insect tissues like the Drosophila head while preserving fine protein structures. The methanol dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation steps effectively remove the cuticle and lipids, essential for deep imaging. The labeling strategy targets Bruchpilot (BRP) to visualize the active zones (T-bars) and Synapsin to label synaptic vesicles clusters, allowing for the precise analysis of synaptic density and spatial organization within neural circuits. Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 are chosen for their brightness and stability under the iDISCO+ chemical treatment.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS (pH 7.4). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 5% H2O2 in methanol (prepared by diluting 30% H2O2 1:5 in MeOH). (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.3 Wash with 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Rehydration and Permeabilization
2.1 Wash with 80% methanol in PBS (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
2.2 Wash with 50% methanol in PBS (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
2.3 Wash with 20% methanol in PBS (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
2.4 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
2.5 Wash with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.7 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% normal donkey serum in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: mouse anti-nc82 (1:100) and rabbit anti-Synapsin (1:200) in solution containing 0.2% Tween-20, 5% normal donkey serum, 0.01% sodium azide in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.2 Wash with 0.2% Tween-20 in PBS (PBST) with 3 changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)
3.3 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Donkey anti-Mouse Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in solution containing 0.2% Tween-20, 5% normal donkey serum in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4.5 Wash with 100% methanol (2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes per wash)

5 Delipidation and Clearing

5.3 Incubation with 100% Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Bruchpilot (BRP/nc82)+Alexa Fluor 488, Synapsin+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to clear small, chitin-rich insect tissues like the Drosophila brain while preserving fine synaptic structures. The methanol dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation steps effectively remove the cuticle and lipids, essential for deep imaging. The immunolabeling strategy targets Bruchpilot (BRP) as a marker for the active zone (T-bar) and Synapsin for the synaptic vesicle cluster, allowing dual-channel 3D reconstruction of distinct functional domains within the same neural circuit. Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 are chosen for their brightness and stability throughout the clearing process.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2 Methanol Dehydration
2.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

3 Rehydration
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.4 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

4 Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% Donkey Serum in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

5 Primary Antibody Incubation
5.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution: Mouse anti-Bruchpilot (nc82) (1:100), Rabbit anti-Synapsin (1:200) in PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 0.02% Sodium Azide, 0.1% Heparin in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

6 Washes
6.1 Incubation with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.2 Incubation with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.3 Incubation with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
6.4 Incubation with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
6.5 Incubation with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation
7.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution: Donkey anti-Mouse Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in PTwH. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

8 Washes
8.1 Incubation with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
8.2 Incubation with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
8.3 Incubation with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
8.4 Incubation with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
8.5 Incubation with PTwH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

9 Dehydration for Clearing
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
9.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

10 Delipidation
10.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 20 mins)

11 Refractive Index Matching
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** BoneClear
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, Osteocalcin+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically optimized for mineralized hard tissues like the skull, effectively decalcifying and clearing bone while preserving fluorescence. This is critical for visualizing the osteogenic lineage within the cranial suture and adjacent bone plates. The combination of DAPI (nuclear stain) and Osteocalcin (a late-stage osteoblast/osteocyte marker) allows for the identification of cell distribution and differentiation stages within the 3D structure of the suture and bone matrix.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with Decalcification Solution (0.5 M EDTA, pH 7.4) for 7 days. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 days)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with BoneClear Solution A (20 wt/vol N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 25 wt/vol Urea, 15 wt/vol Triton X-100 in H2O) for 3 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)

2 Permeabilization and Washing
2.1 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with BoneClear Solution B (20 wt/vol N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 25 wt/vol Urea in H2O) for 1 day. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Buffer (5% Donkey Serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBST) for 1 day. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
3.2 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution (Rabbit anti-Osteocalcin, 1:200 dilution in Blocking Buffer) for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.3 Wash with PBST for 1 day, changing solution 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
3.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Stain Solution (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500; DAPI, 1:1000 in Blocking Buffer) for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.5 Wash with PBST for 1 day, changing solution 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

4 Refractive Index Matching and Imaging
4.1 Incubation with BoneClear Solution C (88 wt/vol Histodenz, 0.5% Naphthol Green B in H2O, RI = 1.56) for 2 days. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)

The selected labeling strategy targets Tyrosine Hydroxylase (TH) to visualize sympathetic nerve fibers, CD31 to delineate the vascular endothelium, and DAPI for nuclear context, directly addressing the scientific goal of mapping neuro-vascular spatial relationships.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Pre-treatment
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.4) at 4°C with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) 3 times to remove EDTA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.3 Dehydration in graded methanol series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (twice) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per step)
1.4 Bleaching with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.5 Rehydration in graded methanol series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per step)
1.6 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Permeabilization and blocking with PBST containing 5% normal donkey serum and 0.2% Tween-20. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: Rabbit anti-TH (1:500) and Hamster anti-CD31 (1:200) diluted in PBST with 1% DMSO and 3% donkey serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.3 Wash with PBST 6 times to remove unbound primary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total)
2.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies and nuclear stain: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), Donkey anti-Hamster Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000) diluted in PBST. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.5 Wash with PBST 6 times to remove unbound secondary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total)

3 Dehydration for Clearing
3.1 Dehydration in graded tert-Butanol (tB) series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (twice) tB in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per step)

4.1 Incubation in a mixture of Dichloromethane (DCM) and 100% tB (1:1 ratio) for intermediate transition. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin, DAPI]
**Justification:** The problem involves clearing a bony structure (otic capsule) surrounding the cochlea. CUBIC is an aqueous, hydrophilic clearing method that is highly effective at decoloring and removing heme from blood-rich and calcified tissues like bone, allowing for deep penetration into the otic capsule without the harsh shrinkage associated with alcohol-based methods (like iDISCO+). This is crucial for preserving the delicate spiral structure and spatial relationships of the sensory epithelium. The labeling strategy uses Phalloidin to directly stain F-actin in the stereocilia of hair cells (identifying IHCs and OHCs) and DAPI for nuclear morphology, avoiding the need for complex immunostaining protocols that might be hindered by the bone.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.4) for 5-7 days to decalcify the otic capsule. (Temperature: RT, Time: 144 hours)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
1.3 Wash with 1x PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Delipidation (CUBIC-L)
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25 wt% Urea, 25 wt% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in H2O) for 3-5 days with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 96 hours)
2.2 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.3 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Fluorescence Labeling
3.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% DMSO, 10% normal goat serum in PBST) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with staining solution containing Phalloidin (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488 or 568 conjugate, 1:200) and DAPI (1:1000) in blocking buffer for 7 days with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 168 hours)
3.3 Wash with PBST for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.4 Wash with PBST for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45 wt% Histidine, 45 wt% Sucrose in H2O, pH adjusted to ~7.5-8.0) for 2-3 days until the tissue becomes transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
4.2 Transfer to fresh CUBIC-R solution for storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Until imaging)

The labeling strategy uses Phalloidin to directly label the F-actin in stereocilia bundles (avoiding antibodies for this structure), an antibody against Myosin VIIa to identify hair cell identity, and DAPI for nuclear visualization. This combination allows for the simultaneous analysis of hair cell presence, bundle integrity, and positional gradients within the intact cochlea.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0) in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3-5 days, change solution daily)

**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin, Hoechst]
**Justification:** CUBIC is selected because it is a highly effective aqueous clearing method for hard, calcified tissues like the otic capsule (bone) surrounding the cochlea, efficiently decalcifying and delipidating the sample without the shrinkage associated with alcohol-based methods (e.g., iDISCO/uDISCO). The labeling strategy utilizes Phalloidin to directly visualize F-actin bundles in stereocilia and hair cell cuticular plates (addressing the goal of assessing stereocilia bundle damage) and Hoechst for nuclear staining to quantify hair cell numbers and arrangement integrity along the cochlear spiral.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Initial Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0) in PBS to decalcify the bony otic capsule. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5-7 days)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS to remove residual EDTA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Wash with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Delipidation (CUBIC-L)
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25 wt% Urea, 25 wt% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in H2O) to clear lipids and permeabilize the tissue. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3-5 days)
2.2 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove clearing reagents. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.3 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

3 Fluorescence Labeling
3.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% Donkey Serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) to reduce non-specific binding. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with Phalloidin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:200) and Hoechst 33342 (5 µg/mL) in staining buffer (0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS) to label F-actin bundles and nuclei. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.3 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove unbound dyes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.4 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45 wt% Sucrose, 30 wt% Urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O) for RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2-3 days)

**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin, Myosin VIIa, DAPI]
**Justification:** PEGASOS is specifically optimized for decalcifying and clearing hard, calcified tissues like the otic capsule while preserving fluorescence, addressing the issue of the opaque bone shell. It uses formamide and aminoalcohols to rapidly remove bone minerals and lipids, allowing deep imaging of the spiral cochlea structure. The labeling strategy uses Phalloidin to directly visualize F-actin/stereocilia bundles and Myosin VIIa to identify hair cells, both compatible with the PEGASOS protocol and available in the provided list, ensuring the assessment of noise damage and cell loss is possible with high signal-to-noise ratio.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with PEGASOS Solution A (20% w/v N-methylglucamine, 10% w/v Triethanolamine, 47.5% vol/vol Formamide, 22.5% vol/vol H2O) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24-48 hours)
1.2 Rinse with 1x PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) to remove residual Solution A. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

2 Permeabilization and Labeling
2.1 Permeabilization with 0.5% vol/vol Triton X-100 in 1x PBS with 5% vol/vol DMSO. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with blocking solution containing 0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100, 5% vol/vol Normal Goat Serum, and 0.02% wt/vol Sodium Azide in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2.3 Incubation with primary antibody against Myosin VIIa (diluted in blocking solution) and Phalloidin conjugate (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488/568, 1:200) for dual labeling. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.4 Wash with 0.2% vol/vol Triton X-100 in 1x PBS containing 0.02% wt/vol Sodium Azide. Repeat 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours per wash)
2.5 Incubation with DAPI (1:1000) in 1x PBS for nuclear counterstaining. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.6 Wash with 1x PBS to remove unbound DAPI. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with PEGASOS Solution B (37% wt/vol Histodenz, 20% wt/vol Polyethylene glycol 400, 0.1M Tris, pH 8.0) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Transfer to fresh PEGASOS Solution B for final RI matching and storage. (Temperature: RT, Time: Until sample is transparent and ready for imaging)

**Chosen Method:** BoneClear
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 488, TH+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically optimized for mineralized tissues like teeth and bone, effectively decalcifying and clearing without destroying the enamel and dentin microstructure. It preserves fluorescence well, allowing for the 3D reconstruction of nerve fibers. PGP9.5 is a pan-neuronal marker to visualize all nerve fibers, while Tyrosine Hydroxylase (TH) specifically labels sympathetic fibers, enabling the distinction required. DAPI provides nuclear context for the pulp tissue structure.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with BoneClear Solution A (10% w/v EDTA, 2.5% w/v Polyvinylpyrrolidone in PBS, pH 7.4) for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.2 Rinse with 1x PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
1.3 Incubation with BoneClear Solution B (20% w/v N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 50% v/v Glycerol, 0.1% v/v Triton X-100 in H2O) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Washing
2.1 Wash with 0.5% v/v Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST) for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

**Chosen Method:** BoneClear
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DAPI]
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically optimized for mineralized tissues like teeth and bone, effectively decalcifying and clearing while preserving hard tissue morphology (enamel/dentin) and internal structures (pulp chamber). Since the goal is to trace the overall path of nerve fibers rather than distinguish subtypes, the lipophilic dye DiI is ideal for anterograde/retrograde tracing of neuronal membranes without requiring immunostaining. DAPI provides a nuclear counterstain to visualize the general pulp tissue architecture.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.4) on a shaker. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 days)
1.2 Rinse with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

2 Nerve Tracing (DiI Labeling)
2.1 Prepare DiI solution (1 mg/ml DiI in 100% ethanol).
2.2 Immerse samples in DiI solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.3 Rinse samples with 1x PBS to remove excess dye. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3 Nuclei Staining (DAPI)
3.1 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/ml in 1x PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Rinse with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5 Delipidation and Clearing
5.1 Incubation with 33% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane in Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
5.2 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane in Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
5.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)

6 Refractive Index Matching
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Benzyl Alcohol / Benzyl Benzoate (BABB) (1:2 ratio). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

**Chosen Method:** BoneClear
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DAPI]
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically optimized for mineralized tissues like teeth, effectively decalcifying and clearing while preserving hard tissue morphology (enamel/dentin) and soft tissue structure. The previous issue of pulp shrinkage likely stemmed from skipping the critical rehydration step between decolorization and BB-PEG treatment. DiI is a lipophilic dye ideal for tracing neuronal membranes and nerve fibers entering from the apex, while DAPI provides nuclear contrast for the overall pulp soft tissue structure. Both are compatible with the BoneClear protocol and do not require immunostaining, minimizing processing time.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Decolorization
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0) to decalcify the tooth. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 days)
1.2 Replace with fresh 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0) and continue incubation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 days)
1.3 Wash with 1x PBS to remove EDTA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.4 Incubation with Decolorization Solution (25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine in H2O) to remove blood/heme. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)

2 Rehydration (Critical Step to Prevent Shrinkage)
2.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) Methanol in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 15% (vol/vol) Methanol in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Staining
3.1 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/mL in 1x PBS) to stain nuclei. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Wash with 1x PBS to remove unbound DAPI. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.3 Incubation with DiI solution (5 µg/mL in 1x PBS) to stain nerve fibers. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.4 Wash with 1x PBS to remove unbound DiI. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4 Optical Clearing and RI Matching
4.1 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) BB-PEG (Benzyl-Benzoate Polyethylene Glycol) in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 40% (wt/vol) BB-PEG in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 60% (wt/vol) BB-PEG in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.4 Incubation with 80% (wt/vol) BB-PEG in 1x PBS (Final RI Matching Solution). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

The scientific goal requires visualizing the overall peripheral nerve network (PGP9.5) and distinguishing thicker, myelinated fibers (MBP). Using Alexa Fluor 488 for PGP9.5 and Alexa Fluor 647 for MBP provides high signal stability and spectral separation compatible with the long-wavelength preservation characteristics of uDISCO.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Decalcification
1.1 Incubation with 0.6 M EDTA in PBS (pH 7.4) for decalcification. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 days)
1.2 Wash with PBS to remove EDTA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) sucrose in PBS for cryoprotection. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

2 Dehydration
2.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

**Justification:** uDISCO is specifically optimized for whole-body clearing of adult mice, achieving high transparency and significant tissue shrinkage (up to 65%), which is crucial for imaging large samples like a 20-25g mouse within the field of view of standard light-sheet microscopes. It is particularly renowned for its superior preservation of red fluorescent proteins (RFP, mCherry, tdTomato) while quenching tissue autofluorescence, which directly addresses the requirement to detect single metastatic cells against background noise. The use of DAPI provides a nuclear counterstain to aid in anatomical orientation and distinguishing single tumor cells from debris.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Sample Preparation & Rehydration
1.1 Wash the fixed whole mouse in 1x PBS for 12 hours to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.2 Incubate in a series of Tetrahydrofuran (THF) / Water mixtures for dehydration: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (twice), each for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per step)
1.3 Incubate in Dichloromethane (DCM) for delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

2 Nuclear Staining (Optional but recommended for orientation)
2.1 Incubate in DAPI staining solution (1 µg/mL DAPI in 100% Methanol) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Wash in 100% Methanol for 6 hours to remove excess dye. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2.3 Re-dehydrate in 100% THF (twice) for 12 hours each to ensure complete water removal before RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per step)

3 Refractive Index (RI) Matching & Clearing
3.1 Incubate in a mixture of 50% Benzyl Alcohol / 50% Benzyl Benzoate (BABB) and 50% DCM for 3 hours to transition. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.2 Incubate in fresh 100% BABB (1:2 Benzyl Alcohol : Benzyl Benzoate) until the sample is transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12-24 hours)
3.3 Transfer to fresh BABB for long-term storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Until imaging)

请根据该科学问题选择兼容的荧光/标记策略，并选择与这些信号兼容的组织透明方法。所选方案应适合完整成年小鼠全身透明化、mCherry/RFP 内源报告信号保留、上皮性肿瘤细胞验证、深层三维成像和单细胞级微转移灶定量。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [mCherry, Pan-Cytokeratin+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO is specifically optimized for whole-body clearing of adult mice, achieving high transparency and significant tissue shrinkage (which facilitates imaging of large samples). It is compatible with endogenous fluorescent proteins like mCherry/RFP and preserves their signal well. The method uses organic solvents, making it ideal for deep-tissue imaging and long-term storage. Pan-Cytokeratin is selected as a robust epithelial marker to validate tumor origin, and Alexa Fluor 647 is chosen for its superior stability and penetration in organic clearing media. DAPI is included for nuclear counterstaining to aid in single-cell resolution and quantification.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF) (first wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF) (second wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Delipidation and Decolorization
2.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

3 Refractive Index Matching
3.1 Incubation with BABB-D (Benzyl Alcohol/Benzyl Benzoate with Diphenyl ether, RI ~1.56). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12-24 hours until transparent)

4 Immunolabeling (Pre-clearing Labeling for Epithelial Marker)
4.1 Permeabilization and blocking with 0.2% Triton X-100, 5% DMSO, 5% normal donkey serum in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Incubation with primary antibody Pan-Cytokeratin (Rabbit anti-Pan-Cytokeratin) diluted 1:500 in 0.2% Triton X-100, 5% DMSO in PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
4.3 Wash with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS (3 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours per wash)
4.4 Incubation with secondary antibody Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 diluted 1:500 in 0.2% Triton X-100, 5% DMSO in PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
4.5 Wash with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS (3 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours per wash)
4.6 Nuclear staining with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.7 Rinse with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin, Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** The primary challenge is the strong light absorption and scattering caused by melanin in the 8–10 mm melanoma. FDISCO (Fast, Deep, and Optically Clearing) is specifically optimized for pigmented tissues and large samples; it rapidly removes lipids and, crucially, bleaches melanin effectively during the delipidation/dehydration steps, allowing deep light penetration for imaging the microvascular network. Since the goal is to visualize the 3D structure of the vasculature, perfusion labeling with fluorescently conjugated Lectin (e.g., Lycopersicon esculentum) prior to sacrifice provides a robust, high-contrast signal of the functional vessel lumen without the need for deep antibody penetration, which is difficult in dense, pigmented tumors. Alexa Fluor 647 is chosen for its superior brightness and stability in the organic solvents used in FDISCO.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Perfusion Labeling (Pre-clearing)
1.1 Cardiac perfusion with PBS containing 50 µg/mL Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated Lectin (e.g., LEL) to label the vasculature lumen. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10-15 minutes)
1.2 Post-perfusion fixation with 4% PFA in PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

2 Dehydration and Melanin Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in deionized water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in deionized water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) (first wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) (second wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) (third wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with Dibenzyl ether (DBE) until the tissue becomes transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12-24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin, CD31+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** The CUBIC (Clear, Unobstructed Brain/Body Imaging Cocktails and Computational Analysis) method is selected for its superior compatibility with high-melanin tissues and excellent preservation of fluorescent signals. The amino-alcohol based reagents (ScaleA2/CUBIC-R1) effectively decolorize melanin by breaking down melanin polymers, which is critical for overcoming the light attenuation and low signal-to-noise ratio caused by the high melanin content in melanoma. Additionally, CUBIC maintains tissue integrity and is compatible with both endogenous fluorescence and immunolabeling. The labeling strategy combines intravenous Lectin injection (prior to sacrifice) to mark the functional perfused lumen, and post-clearing immunolabeling of CD31 (endothelial marker) to visualize the structural vascular network, allowing for the precise comparison of perfusion efficiency versus structural density in the tumor core and periphery.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Perfusion and Functional Labeling
1.1 Intravenous injection of fluorescent Lectin (e.g., DyLight 649 or FITC-Lectin, 5-10 mg/kg) via tail vein 5-10 minutes before cardiac perfusion to label functional vasculature. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 mins circulation)
1.2 Cardiac perfusion with 1x PBS to clear blood, followed by perfusion with 4% PFA in PBS for fixation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 20 mins total)
1.3 Dissect the tumor tissue (8-10 mm diameter) and post-fix in 4% PFA in PBS at 4°C with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6-12 hours)

2 Rehydration and Decolorization (CUBIC-L)
2.1 Wash the tissue with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBST) to remove residual PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubate in CUBIC-L solution (10% w/v N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 10% w/v Urea in H2O) to decolorize melanin and delipidate. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3-7 days, change solution daily until tissue appears transparent)

3 Immunolabeling for Structural Vasculature
3.1 Wash the tissue with 1x PBS to remove CUBIC-L reagent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, 3 changes)
3.2 Permeabilization and blocking with PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100, 0.1% Sodium Azide, and 5% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.3 Incubation with primary antibody against CD31 (e.g., Rat anti-mouse CD31, 1:200 dilution) in PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 and 1% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5-7 days)
3.4 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 to remove unbound primary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, 4 changes)
3.5 Incubation with secondary antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500 dilution) in PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 and 1% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3-5 days)
3.6 Wash with 1x PBS to remove unbound secondary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, 4 changes)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
4.1 Incubation in CUBIC-R(1) solution (45% w/v Sucrose, 30% w/v Urea, 10% w/v 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in H2O) for initial RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12-24 hours)
4.2 Incubation in CUBIC-R(2) solution (50% w/v Sucrose, 25% w/w Urea, 10% w/v 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triethanolamine in H2O) for final clearing and RI matching (RI ~1.52). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12-24 hours)

5 Imaging Preparation
5.1 Mount the cleared tumor tissue in a chamber filled with CUBIC-R(2) solution to prevent dehydration and maintain optical clarity during imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Until imaging)
