**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin, CD31+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** FDISCO is specifically optimized for clearing highly pigmented and lipid-rich tissues like melanoma, as it effectively removes melanin and lipids while preserving fluorescence signals. The method is fast and achieves high transparency, which is critical for deep imaging of the tumor microvascular network. The labeling strategy combines intravascular Lectin (to mark functional perfusion) with CD31 immunolabeling (to mark the total endothelial network), allowing for the simultaneous assessment of structural integrity and perfusion heterogeneity. Alexa Fluor 647 is chosen for its stability and superior penetration in cleared tissues.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Perfusion Labeling (In vivo)
1.1 Intravenous injection of 100 µL FITC-conjugated Lycopersicon esculentum Lectin (1 mg/mL in PBS) via tail vein 5 minutes before sacrifice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 mins circulation)
2 Post-fixation
2.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS at 4°C overnight. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3 Pre-clearing Washes
3.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBST) to remove residual PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.2 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4 Bleaching (Melanin Removal)
4.1 Incubation with 4% H2O2 in PBS (prepared fresh) to quench melanin autofluorescence and decolorize the tissue. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
5 Immunolabeling
5.1 Permeabilization with 0.3% Triton X-100, 0.2% Tween-20, and 20% DMSO in PBS (PTwD) for 2 days. (Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)
5.2 Blocking with 6% Donkey Serum, 5% DMSO, and 0.1% Tween-20 in PBS (PTwB) for 1 day. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.3 Incubation with primary antibody Rat anti-mouse CD31 (1:200) in PTwB. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 days)
5.4 Wash with 0.2% Tween-20 in PBS (PTw) for 1 day, changing solution 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.5 Incubation with secondary antibody Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in PTwB. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 days)
5.6 Wash with PTw for 1 day, changing solution 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
6 Dehydration
6.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF (first wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF (second wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) THF (third wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
7 Refractive Index Matching & Clearing
7.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl ether (DBE) until the tissue becomes transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 mins to 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior decolorization capability using hydrogen peroxide in methanol, which effectively bleaches melanin to reduce light absorption and scattering in pigmented melanoma tissues. The method's robust immunolabeling protocol allows for high-contrast visualization of vascular endothelial structures (CD31) and functional perfusion (Lectin), while the final refractive index matching with dichloromethane/DBE ensures deep tissue penetration for red/far-red fluorescence imaging, essential for 3D reconstruction of tumor vasculature.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with methanol series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (vol/vol) methanol in water, 1 hour each step. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12-16 hours)
1.4 Wash with 100% (vol/vol) methanol, 2 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Rehydration and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with methanol series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, 1 hour each step. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
2.2 Wash with PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 2.5% Glycine. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.4 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% DMSO + 0.3M Glycine. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution: 0.2% Triton X-100, 5% Normal Donkey Serum, 0.01% Sodium Azide in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody solution: Rat anti-mouse CD31 (1:500) and Biotinylated Lectin (1:200) in blocking solution with 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.3 Wash with PBST, 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
3.4 Incubation with secondary antibody solution: Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and Streptavidin Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in blocking solution with 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.5 Wash with PBST, 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
3.6 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/mL in PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with methanol series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (vol/vol) methanol in water, 1 hour each step. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol, 2 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5 Clearing and Refractive Index Matching
5.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
5.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Pan-Cytokeratin+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its rapid clearing capability (24-48 hours) and excellent compatibility with fixed tissues, making it ideal for time-sensitive intraoperative assessment. It preserves fluorescence well and allows for high-resolution 3D imaging of epithelial structures. Pan-Cytokeratin is a robust marker for epithelial cancer cells, and Alexa Fluor 647 provides deep tissue penetration. DAPI is used for nuclear counterstaining to assess tissue architecture and spatial relationships.  

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Preparation  
1.1 Rinse fixed biopsy tissue (5 mm × 5 mm × 3 mm) in PBS (pH 7.4) for 10 minutes to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)  
1.2 Permeabilize tissue with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

2 Immunolabeling  
2.1 Block non-specific binding with 5% normal goat serum in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubate with primary antibody Pan-Cytokeratin (1:200 dilution in blocking solution) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 12 hours)  
2.3 Wash tissue with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) 3 times, 30 minutes each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours total)  
2.4 Incubate with secondary antibody Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated goat anti-mouse (1:500 dilution in blocking solution) for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.5 Wash tissue with PBST 3 times, 30 minutes each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours total)  
2.6 Stain nuclei with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.7 Rinse tissue with PBS for 10 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)  

3 Optical Clearing (CUBIC)  
3.1 Incubate tissue in CUBIC-R1 solution (25 wt% urea, 25 wt% N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in H2O) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 37°C, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Rinse tissue with PBS for 10 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)  
3.3 Incubate tissue in CUBIC-R2 solution (50 wt% sucrose, 25 wt% urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in H2O) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

4 Refractive Index Matching & Imaging Preparation  
4.1 Transfer tissue to CUBIC-R2 solution for final RI matching (RI = 1.48) for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.2 Mount tissue in CUBIC-R2 solution for light-sheet or confocal microscopy. (Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate)

3.4 Incubation with secondary antibody Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated goat anti-mouse (1:500 dilution in blocking solution) and DAPI (1 µg/mL) for 6 hours at RT with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45 wt% sucrose, 30 wt% urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in H₂O) for 6 hours with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

5.1 Mount the cleared tissue in CUBIC-R solution in a glass-bottom dish or imaging chamber. (Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate)  
5.2 Optional: Seal the dish to prevent evaporation during imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate)

**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with fixed clinical tissue samples, high transparency, and superior preservation of fluorescent signals from immunolabeling. The aqueous nature of the reagents minimizes tissue shrinkage and hardening, which is critical for maintaining the delicate 3D architecture of 1 mm diameter prostate needle cores. The labeling strategy targets Pan-Cytokeratin to visualize the glandular epithelium (essential for assessing architectural patterns like cribriform or fused glands) and p63 to identify basal cells (whose absence is a key indicator of malignancy). DAPI provides nuclear density context. This combination allows for the 3D reconstruction of glandular structures and the spatial relationship between luminal epithelium and basal cells, directly supporting Gleason grading criteria.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) ethanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Permeabilization and Decolorization
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% (wt/vol) urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in distilled water). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Blocking
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.5% (wt/vol) carboxymethylcellulose, 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.05% (wt/vol) sodium azide in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Immunolabeling
4.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution containing Mouse anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (1:200) and Rabbit anti-p63 (1:200) diluted in Blocking Solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
4.2 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, change solution every 2 hours)
4.3 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution containing Donkey anti-Mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Rabbit IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) diluted in Blocking Solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
4.4 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, change solution every 2 hours)
4.5 Incubation with DAPI Solution (1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.6 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

5 Clearing and RI Matching
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R(+) solution (45% (wt/vol) antipyrine, 30% (wt/vol) nicotinamide in distilled water). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.2 Incubation with fresh CUBIC-R(+) solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24-48 hours, until tissue is transparent)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Pan-Cytokeratin+Alexa Fluor 488, p63+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** The CUBIC (Clear, Unobstructed Brain/Body Imaging Cocktails and Computational Analysis) method is selected for its superior tissue preservation properties, specifically its ability to minimize the shrinkage and deformation observed in the previous FOCM/DBE protocol. Unlike solvent-based methods (e.g., FOCM, uDISCO) which extract lipids aggressively and cause significant volume reduction, CUBIC uses a mild aminoalcohol-based delipidation and refractive index (RI) matching strategy that maintains the original dimensions of delicate structures like prostate needle cores. This is critical for accurately reconstructing glandular architecture and assessing features like gland fusion and cribriform patterns without distortion. The aqueous nature of CUBIC also preserves endogenous and immunofluorescent signals effectively. The labeling strategy targets Pan-Cytokeratin to visualize the glandular epithelium (highlighting cancerous regions) and p63 to specifically identify the basal cell layer (whose absence is a key diagnostic marker), with DAPI providing nuclear context for Gleason grading.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Sample Preparation & Rehydration
1.1 Rinse fixed biopsy cores in 1x PBS to remove residual fixative.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
1.2 Incubate in a graded methanol series for rehydration if samples were stored in MeOH, or start directly from PBS: 50% MeOH in PBS, then 80% MeOH in PBS, finally 100% MeOH. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
1.3 Rehydrate samples in reverse methanol series: 80% MeOH, 50% MeOH, then PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)

2 Permeabilization and Delipidation (CUBIC-L)
2.1 Incubate samples in CUBIC-L solution (25% Urea, 25% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% Triton X-100 in distilled water) to clear lipids and permeabilize tissue. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24-48 hours)
2.2 Wash samples in 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove clearing reagent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, change solution every 2 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Block samples in blocking buffer (5% Donkey Serum, 0.5% Triton X-100, 0.1% Sodium Azide in PBST) to reduce non-specific binding. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubate with primary antibodies diluted in antibody dilution buffer (5% Donkey Serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBST): Pan-Cytokeratin (1:200) and p63 (1:200). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
3.3 Wash samples in PBST to remove unbound primary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, change solution every 4 hours)
3.4 Incubate with secondary antibodies and nuclear stain diluted in antibody dilution buffer: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-Rabbit (1:500) for Pan-Cytokeratin, Alexa Fluor 647 anti-Mouse (1:500) for p63, and DAPI (1 µg/mL). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.5 Wash samples in PBST to remove unbound secondary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, change solution every 4 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
4.1 Incubate samples in CUBIC-R solution (45% Histodenz, 30% Sucrose, 10% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 0.1% Triton X-100 in distilled water, RI ~1.52) for optical clearing and RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24-48 hours)

5 Imaging Preparation
5.1 Transfer cleared biopsy cores to a glass-bottom dish or imaging chamber filled with fresh CUBIC-R solution, ensuring the tissue is fully immersed and immobilized for 3D imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is an aqueous, hydrophilic clearing method highly effective for small, dense immune organs like lymph nodes (2-3 mm). It preserves endogenous fluorescence and chemical dyes well while being compatible with immunolabeling. The protocol uses a delipidation step (ScaleCUBIC-1) followed by refractive index matching (ScaleCUBIC-2), which is ideal for visualizing the 3D relationship between HEVs (CD31) and dense lymphocyte zones (DAPI) without the harsh shrinkage often associated with solvent-based methods.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Permeabilization and Delipidation (Clearing)
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-1 solution (25% Urea, 25% Quadrol, 15% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24-48 hours)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, change solution every 2 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Buffer (5% Donkey Serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with Primary Antibody solution (Anti-CD31 antibody diluted 1:200 in Blocking Buffer). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
3.3 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, change solution every 4 hours)
3.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Dye solution (Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody diluted 1:500, DAPI diluted 1:1000 in Blocking Buffer). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.5 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, change solution every 4 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching (RI Matching)
4.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-2 in PBS (50% CUBIC-2: 25% Sucrose, 25% Urea, 10% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-2 solution (45% Sucrose, 30% Urea, 10% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12-24 hours)

5 Imaging Preparation
5.1 Transfer sample to imaging chamber filled with fresh 100% CUBIC-2 solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

The labeling strategy uses B220 (a pan-B cell marker) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 to specifically identify B cell follicles, combined with DAPI to provide overall cellular density and structural context of the white and red pulp regions.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Decolorization (CUBIC-L)
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% (wt/vol) urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days, change solution daily)

3 Washing
3.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, change solution every 2 hours)

4 Blocking
4.1 Incubation with Blocking Buffer (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.5% (wt/vol) carboxymethylcellulose, 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.05% (wt/vol) sodium azide in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)

5 Immunolabeling (B Cell Follicles)
5.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody solution (Rat anti-mouse B220 (PTPRC), 1:500 dilution in Blocking Buffer). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, gentle shaking)

5.3 Incubation with Secondary Antibody solution (Donkey anti-rat IgG Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500 dilution in Blocking Buffer). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, gentle shaking)
5.4 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3 times)

6 Nuclear Counterstaining
6.1 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
6.2 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

7 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
7.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45% (wt/vol) antipyrine, 30% (wt/vol) nicotinamide in H2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days, change solution once)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [B220 (PTPRC)+Alexa Fluor 488, CD169+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** The CUBIC (Clear, Unobstructed Brain/Body Imaging Cocktails and Computational Analysis) method is selected for its high compatibility with immunolabeling and excellent preservation of endogenous fluorescence signals. As an aqueous-based clearing technique, it minimizes tissue shrinkage and hardening, which is critical for maintaining the volumetric integrity of the spleen (15 mm × 10 mm × 5 mm) to accurately quantify follicle volume and cell density. The protocol utilizes ScaleCUBIC-1 and ScaleCUBIC-2 reagents to achieve high transparency and refractive index matching suitable for light-sheet microscopy. The labeling strategy targets B220 (B cells) to map B cell follicles and germinal centers, CD169 (metallophilic macrophages) to delineate the marginal zone, and DAPI to visualize overall cell density and nuclear architecture.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Preparation and Pre-treatment
1.1 Rinse fixed spleen with 1× PBS to remove residual fixative.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubate with 0.1% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS to permeabilize the tissue and improve reagent penetration.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubate with blocking solution containing 5% normal donkey serum and 0.1% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS to block non-specific binding sites.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubate with primary antibodies diluted in antibody dilution buffer (0.5% Triton X-100, 1% donkey serum in PBS): anti-B220 (1:500) and anti-CD169 (1:500).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 168 hours)
2.3 Wash with 0.1% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS to remove unbound primary antibodies. Perform 3 washes with fresh solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.4 Incubate with secondary antibodies and nuclear stain diluted in antibody dilution buffer: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-rat (1:500) for B220, Alexa Fluor 647 anti-hamster (1:500) for CD169, and DAPI (1 µg/mL).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 168 hours)
2.5 Wash with 0.1% Triton X-100 in 1× PBS to remove unbound secondary antibodies. Perform 3 washes with fresh solution.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-R1)
3.1 Incubate with CUBIC-R1 solution (25% urea, 25% N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% Triton X-100 in H2O) to decolorize and delipidate the tissue. Replace solution once after 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R2)
4.1 Incubate with CUBIC-R2 solution (50% sucrose, 25% urea, 10% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O) for refractive index matching. Replace solution once after 24 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 48 hours)

5 Storage and Imaging Preparation
5.1 Store the cleared spleen in fresh CUBIC-R2 solution at 4°C protected from light until imaging.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: >24 hours)

我在进行小鼠脾脏透明化实验后发现，生发中心相关信号很弱，且脾脏组织仍然呈暗红色。此前使用 Ce3D protocol，但 decoloration 只进行了 8 小时，并且跳过了 gradient delipidation 步骤后直接进行 RI matching。请根据上述科学目标，在不引入给定标记物列表之外靶点或表外荧光团的前提下，重新选择或调整荧光/标记策略与组织透明方法。修正版应适合完整脾脏富血红素组织的脱色、B 细胞滤泡标记、生发中心区域识别、低背景多通道成像和三维重建。

请仅输出修正后的 protocol，第 1 行写明应保留或更换的荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [B220 (PTPRC)+Alexa Fluor 488, Ki67 (MKI67)+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** The CUBIC method is selected for its superior decolorization capability of hemoglobin-rich organs like the spleen and its excellent compatibility with whole-organ immunolabeling. The previous failure was due to insufficient decolorization time and skipped delipidation. CUBIC's aqueous, alkaline reagents (ScaleCUBIC-R1 and R2) effectively remove heme and lipids while preserving fluorescence, which is critical for detecting weak signals like Ki67 in germinal centers. The labeling strategy targets B220 to visualize B cell follicles and Ki67 to identify proliferating germinal centers, with DAPI for nuclear context.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decolorization and Delipidation (CUBIC-R1 treatment)
1.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R1 solution (25 wt% urea, 25 wt% N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in dH2O) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 to 5 days)
1.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-R1 solution and continue incubation until the splender tissue becomes completely transparent and colorless. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 to 3 days)

2 Washing
2.1 Rinse tissue with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove residual CUBIC-R1. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Wash with 1x PBST with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

3 Permeabilization and Blocking
3.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization solution (0.5% Triton X-100, 5% DMSO, 5% normal donkey serum in 1x PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Immunolabeling
4.1 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in antibody dilution buffer (0.5% Triton X-100, 5% DMSO, 1% normal donkey serum in 1x PBS): anti-B220 (1:500) and anti-Ki67 (1:500). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
4.2 Wash with 1x PBST with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.3 Incubation with secondary antibodies and nuclear stain diluted in antibody dilution buffer: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-rat (1:500), Alexa Fluor 647 anti-rabbit (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
4.4 Wash with 1x PBST with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R2 treatment)
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R2 solution (50 wt% sucrose, 25 wt% urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in dH2O) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-R2 solution and continue incubation until tissue sinks and RI is stable (~1.52). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Storage and Imaging Preparation
6.1 Store sample in fresh CUBIC-R2 solution at 4°C protected from light until imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Long-term)

请根据该科学问题自行选择合适的荧光/标记策略，并匹配适合完整肿瘤免疫微环境成像的组织透明方法。若限制范围内的血管腔面探针或核染料能够提供血管/结构参考，可作为辅助信号；但不能替代 T 细胞亚群主标记。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD3+Alexa Fluor 488, CD8+Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior clearing capability on dense, lipid-rich tumor tissues (8 mm size) and excellent compatibility with immunolabeling. The methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation effectively remove lipids to reveal deep tumor structures while preserving antigenicity for T cell markers. The protocol allows robust whole-mount staining of CD3 (pan-T cell) and CD8 (cytotoxic T cell) to map the immune infiltration gradient, while Lectin provides vascular reference and DAPI outlines the necrotic core and overall architecture.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol for 1 hour to initiate dehydration and remove water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol for 2 hours to complete dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane in Methanol for 3 hours to begin delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane for 15 minutes to remove remaining lipids. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.25 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol for 10 minutes to rehydrate. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.17 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 5% (vol/vol) Hydrogen Peroxide in Methanol for bleaching (to reduce autofluorescence). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.9 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.10 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M Glycine in PBS for 1 hour to quench residual aldehydes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.11 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 3% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum, 0.01% (wt/vol) Sodium Azide in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Primary Antibodies: Rabbit anti-CD3 (1:500), Rat anti-CD8 (1:200), and Biotinylated Lectin (1:200) diluted in antibody diluent (0.2% Tween-20, 5% DMSO, 3% Normal Donkey Serum in PBS) for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)
2.3 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.4 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.5 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.6 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.7 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS overnight. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.8 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies and Dyes: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), Streptavidin-Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500), and DAPI (1 ug/mL) diluted in antibody diluent for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)
2.9 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.10 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.11 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.12 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.13 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS overnight. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Clearing and Refractive Index Matching
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) Methanol in water for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) Methanol in water for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) Methanol in water for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in water for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane in Methanol for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane for 15 minutes to clear tissue. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.25 hours)
3.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane for 15 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.25 hours)
3.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) for RI matching and final clearing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Cx40 + Alexa Fluor 488, Cntn2 + Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to clear dense, intact organs like the mouse heart (10 mm size) while preserving endogenous fluorescence and allowing deep immunolabeling. The methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps effectively remove lipids to achieve high transparency, which is critical for visualizing the deep Purkinje fiber network and ventricular structures. The protocol is compatible with whole-mount immunostaining, enabling the specific targeting of Connexin 40 (Cx40) and Contactin-2 (Cntn2) to map the conduction system. DAPI is included as a nuclear counterstain to visualize the overall myocardial architecture and tissue boundaries.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Permeabilization
1.1 Wash samples in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubate in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST for gradual dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubate in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubate in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubate in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubate in 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.7 Bleach samples using chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.8 Wash samples twice in 100% methanol to remove H2O2. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
1.9 Rehydrate samples through a methanol series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
1.10 Wash samples in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Block and permeabilize samples in blocking solution (5% DMSO, 3% normal donkey serum in PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2.2 Incubate with primary antibodies diluted in antibody solution (3% DMSO, 3% normal donkey serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS): Rabbit anti-Cx40 (1:500) and Goat anti-Cntn2 (1:200). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
2.3 Wash samples with PBST containing 0.2% Tween-20 (4 washes, 1 hour each). (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours total)
2.4 Wash samples with PBST (1 wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubate with secondary antibodies and nuclear stain diluted in antibody solution: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), Donkey anti-Goat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
2.6 Wash samples with PBST containing 0.2% Tween-20 (4 washes, 1 hour each). (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours total)
2.7 Wash samples with PBST (1 wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Dehydrate samples in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Dehydrate samples in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Dehydrate samples in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Dehydrate samples in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Dehydrate samples in 100% (vol/vol) methanol (2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per change)
3.6 Clear samples in Dichloromethane (DCM) (2 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes per change)
3.7 Transfer samples to RI matching solution (Dibenzyl Ether, DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

The labeling strategy uses Lectin to visualize the glomerular capillary loops and filtration barrier, Laminin to outline the glomerular basement membrane and Bowman's capsule for precise segmentation, and DAPI for nuclear localization to count total glomeruli and assess cellularity.

1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% (wt/vol) urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in dH2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

3.2 Incubation with primary antibody solution: Rabbit anti-Laminin (1:500) and Biotinylated Lycopersicon esculentum (Tomato) Lectin (1:200) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.3 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
3.4 Incubation with secondary reagent solution: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated Streptavidin (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 594-conjugated Donkey anti-Rabbit IgG (1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
3.5 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

4.1 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)
4.2 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with whole mouse kidney clearing (size ~10 mm) and superior preservation of endogenous fluorescence and immunolabeling signals. The aqueous, high-pH nature of CUBIC-R reagents efficiently delipidates and clears renal tissue while minimizing protein denaturation, which is critical for detecting fine slit diaphragm structures. The selected labeling strategy targets Nephrin and Podocin, the two key transmembrane proteins of the podocyte slit diaphragm, allowing for the precise assessment of 3D integrity, continuity, and focal loss. DAPI provides nuclear context for glomerular volume analysis. CUBIC's refractive index matching solution (CUBIC-R2) renders the whole kidney transparent and homogeneous, ideal for deep light-sheet or confocal imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Decolorization
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% Urea, 25% Quadrol, 15% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Buffer (5% Donkey Serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
3.2 Incubation with Primary Antibodies: Rabbit anti-Nephrin (1:200) and Guinea Pig anti-Podocin (1:200) in Dilution Buffer (1% Donkey Serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.3 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
3.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Guinea Pig Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in Dilution Buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.5 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

4 Nuclear Counterstaining
4.1 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/mL in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

5 Clearing and Refractive Index Matching
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R(+) solution (45% Urea, 30% Sucrose, 10% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 days)
5.2 Incubation with CUBIC-R(+) solution (Refresh). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)

6 Storage and Imaging
6.1 Store and image in fresh CUBIC-R(+) solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Laminin (LAMA5)+Alexa Fluor 488, Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** The CUBIC method is selected for its superior ability to achieve uniform transparency in dense, heterogeneous organs like the kidney, effectively addressing the issue of inconsistent clearing between cortex and medulla. Its aqueous, high-pH formulation is ideal for preserving endogenous fluorescence and allowing deep penetration of antibodies for detecting podocyte slit diaphragm proteins (Nephrin) and the glomerular basement membrane (Laminin). The protocol is adjusted to extend the delipidation (CUBIC-L) time and include a rehydration step for immunolabeling, ensuring clear glomerular boundary delineation and accurate 3D quantification.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 10% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Incubation with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 5% (vol/vol) DMSO, and 5% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Primary Antibodies: Rabbit anti-Nephrin (1:200) and Rat anti-Laminin (1:500) in 0.5% Triton X-100, 5% DMSO, 5% Serum in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.2 Wash with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS containing 0.1% Sodium Azide. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution 3 times)
3.3 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in 0.5% Triton X-100, 5% DMSO, 5% Serum in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.4 Wash with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS containing 0.1% Sodium Azide. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution 3 times)
3.5 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4 Delipidation (CUBIC-L)
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% Urea, 25% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5-7 days, change solution after day 3)

5 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
5.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
5.2 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 30% Sucrose, 10% Triethanolamine in H2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24-48 hours, until transparent)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [CK19+Alexa Fluor 488, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to clear large, dense organs like the intact mouse liver (20 mm size) while preserving endogenous and immunofluorescent signals. Its methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation effectively remove lipids to allow deep imaging of the biliary tree. The labeling strategy targets CK19 (a specific biliary epithelial marker) to visualize the ductal reaction and network remodeling, while Lectin labels the vasculature to define the portal tract spatial context. DAPI provides nuclear orientation. This combination directly addresses the need to correlate biliary branching with portal zones in 3D.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol to wash and begin dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) to rehydrate. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in Methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes Methanol). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Wash with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Wash with 40% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Permeabilization
3.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Blocking
4.1 Incubation with PBS containing 6% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.1% (wt/vol) Sodium Azide. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5 Primary Antibody Labeling
5.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody solution: Rabbit anti-CK19 (1:500) and Biotinylated Lectin (1:200) diluted in PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20, 5% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum, 0.1% (wt/vol) Sodium Azide. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

6 Washes
6.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3 times)

7 Secondary Antibody Labeling
7.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibody solution: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Streptavidin Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) diluted in PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20, 5% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

8 Nuclear Staining and Final Washes
8.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3 times)
8.2 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
8.3 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

9 Dehydration
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, repeat twice)

10 Delipidation
10.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, repeat twice)

11 Refractive Index Matching
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, until transparent)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [α-SMA, Desmin, Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to clear dense, lipid-rich organs like the lung while preserving fine structural architecture for 3D analysis. The methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps effectively remove lung lipids to ensure uniform transparency, addressing the issue of uneven clearing. The protocol includes a decolorization step (H2O2) which is critical for reducing lung heme autofluorescence and background, thereby enhancing the signal-to-noise ratio for deep imaging. The labeling strategy targets α-SMA (general airway smooth muscle) and Desmin (mature/contractile smooth muscle), providing dual signals to comprehensively assess smooth muscle remodeling, distribution, and hypertrophy. Using Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 ensures high photostability and brightness for deep-tissue light-sheet microscopy.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with Methanol 50% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with Methanol 100% (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)
1.4 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in Methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12-16 hours)
1.5 Wash with Methanol 100% (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)

2 Rehydration and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in dH2O with 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with Methanol 50% (vol/vol) in dH2O with 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with PBS 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with PBS 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 2.5% Glycine. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBS 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)
2.6 Incubation with PBS 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% DMSO + 0.3M Glycine. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.7 Wash with PBS 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.8 Incubation with PBS 0.2% Triton X-100 + 0.1% Heparin + 5% Normal Donkey Serum. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Primary Antibodies: Rabbit anti-α-SMA (1:500) and Chicken anti-Desmin (1:500) diluted in PBS 0.2% Tween-20 + 5% Normal Donkey Serum + 0.01% Sodium Azide. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

5.1 Incubation with Methanol 20% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Insulin, Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to handle large, soft, and irregular tissues like the whole pancreas (15 mm x 8 mm x 3 mm) while achieving deep tissue transparency necessary for light-sheet microscopy. Its methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps effectively preserve endogenous fluorescence and are compatible with robust immunolabeling protocols required to identify specific cell types. The labeling strategy targets Insulin (using a primary antibody and Alexa Fluor 647 secondary) to specifically identify β-cells, avoiding the error-prone estimation from nuclear dyes alone. DAPI is included to provide a reference for total cell density and tissue architecture. This combination ensures precise quantification of β-cell mass and spatial distribution within the intact organ.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Pre-treatment
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T (PBS with 0.1% Triton X-100) for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to bleach autofluorescence.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.7 Wash twice with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour to remove H2O2.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.8 Rehydration: Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.9 Rehydration: Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.10 Rehydration: Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.11 Rehydration: Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.12 Wash with 0.1% PBS-T for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M Glycine in PBS for 1 hour to quench residual aldehydes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M Glycine in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.3 Blocking: Incubation with 0.2% Tween-20, 5% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS (Blocking Solution) for 24 hours with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Primary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with Guinea Pig anti-Insulin antibody diluted 1:500 in Blocking Solution (0.2% Tween-20, 5% NDS, 10% DMSO in PBS) for 7 days with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 168 hours)
3.2 Wash with 0.2% Tween-20 in PBS (PTw.2) for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.3 Wash with PTw.2 for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.4 Wash with PTw.2 for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.5 Wash with PTw.2 for 2 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.6 Wash with PTw.2 overnight.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.7 Secondary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with Donkey anti-Guinea Pig IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 diluted 1:500 in Blocking Solution for 7 days with gentle shaking, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 168 hours)
3.8 Wash with PTw.2 for 1 hour, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.9 Wash with PTw.2 for 1 hour, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.10 Wash with PTw.2 for 1 hour, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.11 Wash with PTw.2 for 2 hours, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.12 Wash with PTw.2 overnight, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4 Nuclear Counterstaining
4.1 Incubation with DAPI (4',6-diamidino-2-phenylindole) diluted 1:1000 in PBS for 24 hours with gentle shaking, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Wash with PBS for 6 hours, changing solution every 2 hours, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

5 Dehydration for Clearing
5.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol twice, each for 1 hour, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in Methanol for 3 hours, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
5.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) twice, each for 15 minutes to remove lipids, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

6 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) until the tissue is transparent (approx. 15-30 minutes), protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
6.2 Storage and Imaging: Store sample in 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) at 4°C or RT until imaging, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Insulin+Alexa Fluor 488, PDX1+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** The iDISCO+ protocol is selected because it is specifically optimized for whole-organ immunolabeling and clearing of soft, fragile tissues like the pancreas. Unlike the previously failed CUBIC attempt (which caused structural damage likely due to aggressive delipidation at 45°C), iDISCO+ uses a graded methanol dehydration and dichloromethane (DCM) delipidation step at room temperature, which better preserves tissue morphology and antigenicity. This method is highly effective for deep penetration of antibodies required to detect low-abundance targets like Insulin and transcription factors like PDX1 throughout the entire 15 mm organ. The final refractive index matching with dibenzyl ether (DBE) renders the pancreas transparent and suitable for high-resolution 3D quantification of islet structures.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 6% (vol/vol) H2O2 in methanol (diluted from 30% stock). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3 Rehydration for Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.6 Incubation with PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Permeabilization
4.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

5 Blocking
5.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20, 10% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum, 5% (vol/vol) DMSO in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Primary Antibody Incubation
6.1 Incubation with Primary Antibodies: Guinea pig anti-Insulin (1:500) and Rabbit anti-PDX1 (1:500) in PBS with 0.2% Tween-20, 5% Normal Donkey Serum, 5% DMSO. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

7 Washes
7.1 Incubation with PBS with 0.2% Tween-20. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution 3 times)

8 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining Incubation
8.1 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies: Donkey anti-Guinea pig Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), plus DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS with 0.2% Tween-20, 5% Normal Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

9 Washes
9.1 Incubation with PBS with 0.2% Tween-20. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution 3 times)

10 Dehydration for Clearing
10.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
10.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

11 Delipidation
11.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours, change solution once after 1.5 hours)

12 Refractive Index Matching
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours until transparent)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH (Tyrosine Hydroxylase) + Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin + Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its superior ability to clear large, lipid-dense adipose tissue samples (15 mm x 10 mm x 5 mm) rapidly while shrinking the tissue to facilitate imaging depth. It preserves endogenous and immunofluorescent signals effectively, particularly red-shifted fluorophores like Alexa Fluor 647, which is ideal for deep-tissue imaging of sympathetic nerves. The strategy uses TH to specifically label sympathetic fibers, Lectin to outline the vasculature (as requested), and DAPI for nuclear context. The high refractive index matching solution provides excellent transparency for light-sheet microscopy.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Permeabilization
1.1 Wash samples in PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.7 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) for bleaching. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.8 Wash samples in 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Rehydration: Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Rehydration: Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Rehydration: Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Rehydration: Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Rehydration: Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Permeabilization and Blocking: Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 0.3M Glycine, and 20% DMSO (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.7 Primary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with Rabbit anti-TH (1:500) and Lectin-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:100) in PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 5% normal donkey serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
2.8 Wash: Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 and 20% DMSO. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution once)
2.9 Secondary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-10 and 10% DMSO. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
2.10 Wash: Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution once)
2.11 Nuclear Staining: Incubation with DAPI (1:1000) in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Dehydration for Clearing
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)
3.6 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes, repeat twice)

4 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
4.1 Incubation with BABB-D (Benzyl Alcohol/Benzyl Benzoate with Diphenyl ether, RI ~1.56) for final clearing and RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours until transparent)
4.2 Store and image in BABB-D solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: Long-term storage)

The method's high transparency (RI ~1.48-1.52) effectively clears the 10 mm tissue size, reducing background autofluorescence from blood and allowing deep imaging of the complex villous tree. The combination of Lectin (functional perfusion) and CD31 (endothelial integrity) provides comprehensive structural and functional data required to study pre-eclampsia.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Perfusion Labeling (Pre-clearing)
1.1 Cardiac perfusion with PBS containing 50 µg/mL FITC-conjugated Lectin (e.g., Lycopersicon esculentum) to label functional perfusion vessels. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)
1.2 Post-fixation with 4% PFA in PBS for 24 hours to secure the Lectin signal. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

2 Rehydration & Decolorization
2.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R1 (25 wt% urea, 25 wt% N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in H2O) in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R1. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24-48 hours, change solution once)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Wash with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST) 3 times to remove residual CUBIC-R1. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
3.2 Permeabilization and blocking with 5% normal donkey serum and 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.3 Incubation with primary antibody Rat anti-mouse CD31 (PECAM-1) diluted 1:200 in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
3.4 Wash with PBST 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours per wash)
3.5 Incubation with secondary antibody Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 647 diluted 1:500 in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.6 Wash with PBST 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours per wash)

4 Optical Clearing
4.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R2 (45 wt% sucrose, 30 wt% urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O) in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R2 for refractive index matching and final clearing. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24-48 hours, until transparent)

5 Storage & Imaging Preparation
5.1 Store samples in fresh 100% CUBIC-R2 solution at 4°C protected from light until imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Long-term)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin, CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with large, dense tissues like the placenta (10 mm size) and its superior preservation of endogenous fluorescence and chemical dyes. The aqueous nature of CUBIC (ScaleA2/B2 or CUBIC-R) is ideal for maintaining the morphology of delicate vascular structures without the shrinkage associated with solvent-based methods (like uDISCO). The labeling strategy combines **Lectin** (perfused functional vessel lumen marker), **CD31** (endothelial structural marker), and **DAPI** (nuclear counterstain). This combination directly addresses the scientific goal of distinguishing between "endothelial structure" and "functional perfusion" to analyze spatial overlap and vascular dysfunction in the preeclampsia model.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Perfusion and Fixation (Pre-clearing)
1.1 Cardiac perfusion with 1x PBS to clear blood, followed by perfusion with 4% PFA in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10-15 mins)
1.2 Post-fixation of dissected placenta in 4% PFA in PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.3 Rinse tissue with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Functional Labeling (Lectin Perfusion)
2.1 Cardiac perfusion with fluorescently labeled Lectin (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488/594 conjugated Lectin, 5-10 µg/mL in PBS) prior to sacrifice to label functional vasculature. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5-10 mins)
2.2 Post-perfusion incubation in 4% PFA to cross-link the Lectin. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12-24 hours)

3 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-L)
3.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25 wt% Urea, 25 wt% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in dH2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3-5 days)
3.2 Refresh CUBIC-L solution halfway through the incubation period. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: Midpoint)

4 Immunolabeling (Endothelial Structure)
4.1 Wash tissue with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove residual CUBIC-L. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, 3 changes)
4.2 Permeabilization and blocking with PBST containing 5% normal serum and 0.5% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.3 Incubation with primary antibody against CD31 (e.g., Rat anti-mouse CD31, 1:200 dilution) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5-7 days)
4.4 Wash with PBST to remove unbound primary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, 4-6 changes)
4.5 Incubation with secondary antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500 dilution) and DAPI (1:1000) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5-7 days)
4.6 Wash with PBST to remove unbound secondary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, 4-6 changes)

5 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45 wt% Sucrose, 30 wt% Urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in dH2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1-2 days)
5.2 Transfer to fresh CUBIC-R solution for final RI matching and storage until imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin, Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with fixed tissues, high transparency for organs of this size (10 mm), and superior preservation of fluorescent signals like Alexa Fluor dyes and DAPI. Its aqueous nature minimizes tissue shrinkage compared to alcohol-based methods, which is critical for accurately measuring the 3D spatial relationships of the placental vascular tree. The labeling strategy uses Lectin (e.g., Lycopersicon esculentum) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 to specifically label functional perfused vasculature (as requested), combined with DAPI to visualize the overall tissue architecture and cellular density, allowing for the analysis of perfusion efficiency and structural integrity.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Perfusion Labeling (Pre-clearing)
1.1 Cardiac perfusion with 1x PBS to clear blood.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 min)
1.2 Cardiac perfusion with 4% PFA in PBS for fixation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min)
1.3 Cardiac perfusion with Fluorescent Lectin (e.g., Alexa Fluor 647 conjugated Lycopersicon esculentum Lectin, 5 µg/mL in PBS) to label functional vasculature.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 min)
1.4 Post-fixation in 4% PFA in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2 Rehydration & Delipidation (CUBIC-L)
2.1 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% Urea, 25% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% Triton X-100 in H2O) for delipidation and decolorization.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days, change solution daily)

3 Nuclear Staining
3.1 Wash with 1x PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.2 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/mL in PBS) for nuclear counterstaining to visualize tissue structure.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
4.1 Wash with 1x PBS to remove excess dye.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.2 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (50% Sucrose, 25% Urea, 10% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O) for RI matching.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days, change solution once)

5 Storage & Imaging
5.1 Store sample in fresh CUBIC-R solution at 4°C protected from light until imaging.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Long-term)
5.2 Mount sample in a quartz cuvette or chamber filled with CUBIC-R solution for Light-sheet or Confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate)

The labeling strategy combines CD31 (endothelial marker) to visualize the vascular tree structure and Lectin to highlight the functional perfused lumen, addressing the scientific goal of comparing branching density and perfusion continuity. 1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.5 Incubation with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, SYTO 16, GFP (内源)]
**Justification:** CUBIC (Clear, Unobstructed Brain/Body Imaging Cocktails and Computational analysis) is selected because it is a highly aqueous, gentle clearing method ideal for delicate tissues like the testis. The problem statement highlights that the tissue structure is easily damaged by strong dehydration or bleaching; CUBIC's aminoalcohol-based delipidation preserves tissue morphology and fluorescence better than organic solvent-based methods (like uDISCO or iDISCO+). The sample size (8 mm) is well-suited for CUBIC's rapid clearing speed. The labeling strategy utilizes DAPI for general nuclear morphology to visualize cell layers, SYTO 16 (a cell-permeant nucleic acid stain compatible with CUBIC) to enhance cytoplasmic/nuclear contrast, and endogenous GFP (if available via transgenic lines) or immunolabeling for specific markers of meiosis (though the protocol below focuses on the clearing and nuclear staining strategy requested). This combination allows for the visualization of the overall distribution of germ cells and the spatial arrangement of seminiferous tubules in 3D.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 100% PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Washing
2.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

3 Nuclear Staining (Optional but recommended for 3D structure)
3.1 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/mL in PBS) or SYTO 16 (1 µM in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-L)
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% (wt/vol) Urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3-5 days)
4.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-L solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2-3 days)

5 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (50% (wt/vol) Sucrose, 25% (wt/vol) Urea, 10% (wt/vol) 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in H2O, RI ~1.48). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1-2 days)
5.2 Incubation with CUBIC-R(+) solution (45% (wt/vol) Sucrose, 30% (wt/vol) Urea, 10% (wt/vol) 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in H2O, RI ~1.50) for higher transparency if needed. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

6 Storage and Imaging
6.1 Store the sample in CUBIC-R or CUBIC-R(+) solution at 4 ℃ protected from light until imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Long-term)

The labeling strategy uses DAPI to visualize nuclear layers (spermatogonia, spermatocytes, spermatids) and Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated Laminin to outline the basal lamina of the tubules, allowing for the precise reconstruction of the tubule network and the spatial analysis of germ cell layers.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Permeabilization and Decolorization
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% (wt/vol) urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days, change solution daily)

3 Washing
3.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution twice)

4 Immunolabeling
4.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4.3 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3 times)

4.5 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3 times)

5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R(+) solution (45% (wt/vol) antipyrine, 30% (wt/vol) nicotinamide in H2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days, until transparent)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC  
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, GFP, Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** CUBIC is an aqueous, hydrophilic clearing method that preserves tissue morphology and fluorescence better than alcohol-based methods like iDISCO+ for delicate structures like seminiferous tubules. It avoids the harsh dehydration and decolorization steps that caused structural damage and signal loss in the previous experiment. The protocol is optimized for whole mouse testes (8 mm × 5 mm × 4 mm), ensuring retention of spermatogenic layers and strong signals for RNA helicase (GFP) and synaptonemal complex proteins (Alexa Fluor 647). DAPI provides nuclear counterstaining for spatial context. The refractive index matching step (CUBIC-R2) ensures high transparency for 3D imaging.  

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Rehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 10% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Permeabilization and Blocking  
2.1 Incubation with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Immunostaining  
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-GFP (1:500) and anti-synaptonemal complex protein (1:200) in 0.5% Triton X-100 and 5% donkey serum in PBS for 7 days. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 7 days)  
3.2 Wash with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 12 hours (change solution every 4 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-chicken (1:500) in 0.5% Triton X-100 and 5% donkey serum in PBS for 7 days. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 7 days)  
3.4 Wash with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 12 hours (change solution every 4 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
3.5 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 24 hours)  

4 Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L (25% (wt/vol) urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in water) for 3 days. (Temperature: 37°C, Time: 3 days)  
4.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-L and incubate for another 3 days. (Temperature: 37°C, Time: 3 days)  

5 Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R1 (45% (wt/vol) sucrose, 30% (wt/vol) urea, 10% (wt/vol) 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in water) for 2 days. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)  
5.2 Incubation with CUBIC-R2 (45% (wt/vol) sucrose, 30% (wt/vol) urea, 10% (wt/vol) 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in water) for 2 days. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)  

6 Storage and Imaging  
6.1 Store in CUBIC-R2 at 4°C until imaging. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: Indefinite)  
6.2 Image using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate filters for DAPI, GFP, and Alexa Fluor 647. (Temperature: RT, Time: As needed)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488, PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to clear dense, lipid-rich tissues like the intestinal wall while preserving endogenous fluorescence and allowing deep immunolabeling. The methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation steps effectively remove lipids from the smooth muscle layers, rendering the 6 cm long colon segment transparent. This method is compatible with long-term storage and refractive index matching in dibenzyl ether (DBE), which is ideal for high-resolution 3D imaging of large samples. The labeling strategy utilizes Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 to visualize F-actin in smooth muscle (circular and longitudinal layers) and PGP9.5-Alexa Fluor 647 to specifically label enteric neurons and nerve fibers in the myenteric and submucosal plexuses. DAPI provides nuclear reference. This combination allows for the precise reconstruction of the spatial relationship between the enteric nervous system and the muscular layers of the colon.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with Methanol 20% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with Methanol 40% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with Methanol 60% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% Methanol (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in Methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.7 Wash with 100% Methanol (vol/vol) twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours per wash)

2 Rehydration and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in dH2O with 0.2% PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Methanol 60% (vol/vol) in dH2O with 0.2% PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.3 Incubation with Methanol 40% (vol/vol) in dH2O with 0.2% PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.4 Incubation with Methanol 20% (vol/vol) in dH2O with 0.2% PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 (0.2% PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.6 Incubation with 0.2% PBST with 20% DMSO (vol/vol), 0.3M Glycine. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.7 Incubation with 0.2% PBST with 10% DMSO (vol/vol), 0.2% Tween-20 (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody solution: Rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 488 Phalloidin (1:200) in PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 0.01% Sodium Azide, 0.1% Heparin in PBS) with 5% normal donkey serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.2 Wash with PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 0.01% Sodium Azide, 0.1% Heparin in PBS) 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours per wash)
3.3 Wash with PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 0.01% Sodium Azide, 0.1% Heparin in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibody solution: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and DAPI (1:1000) in PTwH with 3% normal donkey serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
3.5 Wash with PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 0.01% Sodium Azide, 0.1% Heparin in PBS) 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours per wash)
3.6 Wash with PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 0.01% Sodium Azide, 0.1% Heparin in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with Methanol 20% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.2 Incubation with Methanol 40% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.3 Incubation with Methanol 60% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.4 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.5 Incubation with Methanol 100% (vol/vol) twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)

5 Delipidation and Clearing
5.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM) twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes per wash)
5.2 Incubation with 100% Methanol (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
5.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE (Dibenzyl ether, Sigma 108014-1KG) until sample is transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
