The protocol effectively decolorizes the RPE pigment layer, significantly reducing light absorption and background signal for deep imaging. The labeling strategy utilizes Lectin to directly visualize the retinal vascular network and NeuN (Alexa Fluor 647) to specifically identify retinal ganglion cells, fulfilling the scientific goal of analyzing their distribution and spatial relationships.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% (wt/vol) urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)

3.2 Incubation with primary antibody solution (Anti-NeuN Rabbit IgG, 1:500 dilution) and Lectin solution (Alexa Fluor 488 conjugated Lectin, 1:100 dilution) in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is selected for its excellent compatibility with fixed whole mouse eyes, providing high transparency while preserving endogenous fluorescent proteins (GFP) and chemical dyes (Alexa Fluor 647). Its aqueous nature minimizes tissue shrinkage compared to organic solvent methods, which is critical for accurate cell counting and spatial analysis of the retina. The protocol allows for deep penetration of antibodies and dyes, enabling the simultaneous visualization of RGC identity markers (e.g., GFP-labeled RGCs), transcription factors (labeled with Alexa Fluor 647), and nuclear reference (DAPI) without dissection.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Permeabilization and Decolorization
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% (wt/vol) urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)

3 Washing
3.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution twice)

4 Immunolabeling
4.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium azide in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)
4.2 Incubation with primary antibody (e.g., Rabbit anti-Transcription Factor) diluted in blocking buffer (1:500). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
4.3 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3 times)
4.4 Incubation with secondary antibody (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647) and DAPI (1 µg/mL) diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
4.5 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3 times)

5 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R+ solution (45% (wt/vol) antipyrine, 30% (wt/vol) nicotinamide in H2O, RI ~1.52). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days, change solution once)
5.2 Incubation with fresh CUBIC-R+ solution for final clearing and storage. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Permeabilization and Decolorization
1.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25 wt% Urea, 25 wt% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in H2O) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC  
**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** CUBIC is selected for its superior ability to decolorize and clear pigmented tissues like the RPE layer, which is critical for reducing background and light absorption in whole mouse eyeballs. Its aqueous-based formulation preserves endogenous fluorescence (e.g., GFP in retinal ganglion cells) and allows for deep imaging of vascular networks labeled with Lectin. The extended clearing times (compared to EyeCi) ensure complete delipidation and RI matching, enabling high-resolution 3D reconstruction of retinal layers and vasculature.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Post-Fixation and Washing  
1.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 24 hours)  
1.2 Wash with PBS 3 times, 30 minutes each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours total)  

2 RPE Decolorization and Delipidation (CUBIC-L)  
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% urea, 25% N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% Triton X-100 in H2O) for 48 hours. (Temperature: 37°C, Time: 48 hours)  
2.2 Wash with PBS 3 times, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

3 Immunolabeling and Vascular Staining  
3.1 Permeabilization with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Blocking with 5% normal goat serum in PBS for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with Lectin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (5 µg/mL) and DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS for 48 hours. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 48 hours)  
3.4 Wash with PBS 5 times, 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 hours total)  

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)  
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45% sucrose, 30% urea, 10% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with fresh CUBIC-R solution for an additional 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Transfer eyeball to imaging chamber filled with CUBIC-R solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate)  
5.2 Mount sample for light-sheet or confocal microscopy. (Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate)

2.1 Incubate with blocking solution containing 5% normal donkey serum and 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

2.6 Incubate with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS for nuclear staining. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [DAPI, Phalloidin, Ki67+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** CUBIC is selected for its high compatibility with 3D organoids, excellent preservation of fluorescence signals (crucial for detecting Ki67 and Phalloidin), and rapid clearing capability suitable for high-throughput screening. The aqueous nature of CUBIC avoids the shrinkage associated with organic solvent-based methods, ensuring accurate volumetric measurements. The combination of DAPI (total nuclei), Phalloidin (structural outline), and Ki67 (proliferation) directly addresses the scientific goals of assessing growth, density, and drug effects.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Sample Preparation & Rehydration
1.1 Wash fixed organoids (4% PFA) with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)
1.2 Incubate with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Immunolabeling & Staining
2.1 Block non-specific binding with Blocking Solution (3% Donkey Serum, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Incubate with Primary Antibody against Ki67 (Rabbit anti-Ki67, 1:500) diluted in Antibody Diluent (1% Donkey Serum, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Wash with PBST to remove unbound primary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, change buffer every 30 min)
2.4 Incubate with Secondary Antibody (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500), Phalloidin (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate, 1:200), and DAPI (1 µg/mL) diluted in Antibody Diluent. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBST to remove unbound dyes and antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, change buffer every 30 min)

3 Delipidation & Clearing (CUBIC-L)
3.1 Incubate with CUBIC-L solution (25% Urea, 25% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6-12 hours, until transparent)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
4.1 Incubate with CUBIC-R solution (45% Sucrose, 30% Urea, 10% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.2 Transfer to fresh CUBIC-R solution for final RI matching and storage prior to imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Ki67, PCNA, DAPI]  
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with fixed brain organoids, providing rapid clearing with minimal structural deformation—critical for maintaining organoid integrity during high-throughput screening. The aqueous-based formulation preserves endogenous fluorescence and allows robust immunolabeling of proliferation markers (Ki67, PCNA) and nuclear staining (DAPI). This method efficiently matches refractive indices for deep imaging, enabling accurate volumetric and spatial analysis of drug effects on 3D organoid growth and proliferation.  

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Fixation  
1.1 Incubation with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS (pH 7.4) (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)

**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to clear dense, collagen-rich tissues like human skin biopsies while preserving fine structural details such as intraepidermal nerve fibers (IENFs). The methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps effectively remove lipids to achieve high transparency, which is critical for visualizing the 3D distribution of nerves from the dermal-epidermal junction through the epidermis. PGP9.5 is the gold-standard pan-neuronal marker for visualizing IENFs in skin biopsies, and Alexa Fluor 488 provides high brightness and photostability for deep imaging. DAPI is included to delineate epidermal layers and nuclei, aiding in the assessment of nerve density relative to the tissue structure.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with Methanol 50% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with Methanol 100% (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in Methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.5 Wash with Methanol 100% (vol/vol) twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours per wash)

2 Rehydration and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in dH2O with 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Methanol 50% (vol/vol) in dH2O with 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.3 Incubation with dH2O with 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.4 Incubation with PBS 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution (5% Normal Donkey Serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.2 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution (Rabbit anti-PGP9.5, 1:500 dilution in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 and 0.01% Sodium Azide). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
3.3 Wash with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours per wash)
3.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Stain Solution (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488, 1:500; DAPI, 1:1000 in PBST). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.5 Wash with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours per wash)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with Methanol 20% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.2 Incubation with Methanol 40% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.3 Incubation with Methanol 60% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.4 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.5 Incubation with Methanol 100% (vol/vol) twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)

5 Delipidation and Clearing
5.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM) twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min per wash)
5.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 min)

6 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) until sample is transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 488, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is selected for its excellent compatibility with 3D imaging of soft tissues like skin, high transparency, and superior preservation of fluorescent signals and antigenicity compared to solvent-based methods. The aqueous nature of CUBIC prevents the shrinkage and hardening often associated with alcohol-based clearing (e.g., iDISCO+), which is critical for maintaining the spatial relationship between delicate epidermal nerve fibers and the dermal vascular network. The labeling strategy uses PGP9.5 (a pan-neuronal marker) to visualize intraepidermal nerve fibers (IENF) and Lectin to label the vasculature, combined with DAPI for nuclear orientation.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Fixation and Pre-treatment
1.1 Incubation with 4% Paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS at 4°C with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS to remove excess PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 x 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS for permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Immunolabeling and Staining
2.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution (5% Donkey Serum, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution: Rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500) and Biotinylated Lectin (e.g., IB4, 1:100) in 0.1% Triton X-100/PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.3 Wash with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 x 6 hours)
2.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Streptavidin Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in 0.1% Triton X-100/PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.5 Incubation with DAPI Solution (1 µg/mL in PBS) for nuclear staining. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.6 Wash with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 x 6 hours)

3 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-L)
3.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% Urea, 25% Quadrol, 15% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3-5 days)
3.2 Wash with 1x PBS to remove residual CUBIC-L. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 x 6 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45% Sucrose, 30% Urea, 10% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2-3 days)
4.2 Transfer to fresh CUBIC-R solution for final RI matching before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5, CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is selected for its superior ability to decolorize and clear human skin tissue by removing melanin and heme, which addresses the specific issue of light absorption and background interference caused by epidermal melanin. Its aqueous, isotonic nature minimizes tissue deformation, which is critical for accurate 3D reconstruction and density analysis of IENFs. The labeling strategy uses PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal marker) to robustly visualize the weak intraepidermal nerve fibers, CD31 to outline the superficial dermal vascular network as a spatial reference, and DAPI for nuclear orientation. This combination ensures reliable identification and counting of nerve fibers against a cleared background.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-L (ScaleA2 solution) in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) CUBIC-L in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R (ScaleB2 solution) in PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R in PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 75% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R in PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-R containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Blocking Solution (5% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum in PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Immunostaining
3.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution (Rabbit anti-PGP9.5 1:500, Rat anti-CD31 1:200, DAPI 1:1000 in Blocking Solution). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
3.2 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, change solution every 2 hours)
3.3 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 1:500, Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 647 1:500 in Blocking Solution). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.4 Wash with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, change solution every 2 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
4.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R+ (Refractive Index Matching Solution) in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-R+. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

1.1 Incubation with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

3.1 Incubation with RIM solution (80% Glycerol in 1x PBS) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** ScaleS
**Chosen Labeling:** [EGFP, mCherry, DAPI]
**Justification:** ScaleS is an aqueous-based clearing method specifically optimized for preserving fluorescent protein signals (EGFP, mCherry) in delicate tissues like *C. elegans*. It achieves high transparency (RI ~1.38) without the use of organic solvents or harsh detergents that can quench fluorescence or distort morphology. This makes it ideal for high-resolution 3D imaging of the nerve ring and fine neuronal processes. The protocol utilizes the endogenous fluorescence directly, with DAPI added as a nuclear counterstain to aid in anatomical orientation.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 1x PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 15 minutes to wash off storage buffer. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
1.2 Incubation with 1x PBS for 5 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 minutes)

2 Nuclear Staining (Optional)
2.1 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/mL in 1x PBS) for 30 minutes to label nuclei for anatomical reference. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
2.2 Wash with 1x PBS for 10 minutes to remove excess dye. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)

3 Optical Clearing (ScaleS)
3.1 Incubation with ScaleS-A solution (4 M Urea, 10% Glycerol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in 0.1x PBS) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with ScaleS-B solution (4 M Urea, 30% Glycerol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in 0.1x PBS) for 12 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.3 Incubation with ScaleS-C solution (4 M Urea, 50% Glycerol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in 0.1x PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
4.1 Transfer sample to ScaleS-C(+) solution (4 M Urea, 60% Glycerol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in 0.1x PBS, RI ~1.38) for final clearing and imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Store and image the sample in ScaleS-C(+) solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: >1 week)

**Chosen Method:** ScaleS
**Chosen Labeling:** [EGFP, mCherry, DAPI]
**Justification:** ScaleS is specifically optimized for preserving fluorescent protein signals (EGFP, mCherry) in delicate, small tissues like C. elegans while achieving high transparency. Its aqueous, mild formulation (containing urea and sorbitol) avoids the harsh dehydration or high temperatures of solvent-based methods (like uDISCO or iDISCO+), which can quench fluorescence or distort the fine morphology of the nerve ring and nerve cords. The addition of DAPI provides a nuclear reference to assess the spatial organization of neuronal somata relative to the neuropil.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Sample Preparation and Fixation
1.1 Wash worms in 1x PBS buffer to remove bacteria and debris. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)
1.2 Fixation with 4% PFA in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
1.3 Wash 3 times with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes per wash)

2 Nuclear Staining (Optional)
2.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Wash 3 times with 1x PBS to remove excess dye. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes per wash)

3 Optical Clearing (ScaleS)
3.1 Incubation with ScaleS-A solution (4 M urea, 10% w/v glycerol, 0.1% v/v Triton X-100 in 0.1 M PBS, pH 7.4). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Incubation with ScaleS-B solution (4 M urea, 30% w/v glycerol, 0.1% v/v Triton X-100 in 0.1 M PBS, pH 7.4). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.3 Incubation with ScaleS-C solution (4 M urea, 50% w/v glycerol, 0.1% v/v Triton X-100 in 0.1 M PBS, pH 7.4). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
4.1 Transfer and store samples in ScaleS-C solution (RI ~1.38) for imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin, Myosin VIIa+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with small, whole-organism samples like 5 dpf zebrafish larvae, providing high transparency and rapid clearing without significant tissue shrinkage. Its aqueous nature preserves the morphology of delicate F-actin/ stereocilia bundles labeled by Phalloidin and allows for robust immunolabeling of hair cell markers (Myosin VIIa) to confirm cell identity. The method's high refractive index matching solution is ideal for high-resolution imaging of the lateral line system.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
1.2 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
1.3 Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.1% (wt/vol) Sodium Azide, and 5% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

3 Immunolabeling and Staining
3.1 Incubation with primary antibody Rabbit anti-Myosin VIIa (1:500) and Phalloidin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 or 546 (1:200) diluted in blocking solution containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.2 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
3.3 Incubation with secondary antibody Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and DAPI (1:1000) diluted in blocking solution containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.4 Wash with PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

4 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-L)
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% (wt/vol) Urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 12-24 hours)

5 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45% (wt/vol) Sucrose, 30% (wt/vol) Urea, 10% (wt/vol) 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in H2O, RI ~1.48). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin, Myosin VIIa+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** CUBIC is highly effective for clearing small, whole vertebrate embryos like 5 dpf zebrafish while preserving endogenous fluorescence and chemical dyes. Its aqueous, alkaline formulation is compatible with Phalloidin, which requires specific pH conditions to bind F-actin effectively, unlike organic solvent-based methods (e.g., iDISCO+, uDISCO) that can disrupt F-actin or quench fluorescence. Myosin VIIa is a specific marker for hair cell identity, and combining it with Phalloidin allows simultaneous visualization of the hair cell body and the stereocilia bundles (F-actin) to assess morphology and orientation.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS to rehydrate samples. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 min)
1.3 Incubation with PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) for permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 0.1% (wt/vol) sodium citrate for antigen retrieval (optional but recommended for Myosin VIIa). (Temperature: 80 ℃, Time: 30 min)
1.5 Wash 3 times with PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min per wash)

2 Blocking and Staining
2.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution (PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, and 5% normal goat serum). (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Primary Antibody against Myosin VIIa (e.g., Rabbit anti-Myosin VIIa, 1:500) and Phalloidin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 or 546 (e.g., 1:200) diluted in Blocking Solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
2.3 Wash 3 times with PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 0.1% DMSO. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)
2.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibody (e.g., Goat anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500) diluted in Blocking Solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.5 Wash 3 times with PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)

3 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-L)
3.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% (wt/vol) urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24-48 hours)
3.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-L solution and continue incubation until samples become transparent. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
4.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) CUBIC-R solution in PBS (CUBIC-R: 45% (wt/vol) sucrose, 30% (wt/vol) urea, 10% (wt/vol) 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in H2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 100% CUBIC-R solution for final RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5 Imaging Preparation
5.1 Mount samples in fresh CUBIC-R solution in a chamber suitable for light-sheet or confocal microscopy. (Temperature: RT, Time: Until imaging)

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Wash
1.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS for 30 minutes to re-fix the sample after previous processing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

2.1 Permeabilization with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Incubation with blocking solution (2% BSA, 0.1% Tween-20 in PBS) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.3 Incubation with Phalloidin (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488 or 568 conjugate, 1:200) and DAPI (1:1000) in blocking solution for 24 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.4 Wash with 0.1% Tween-20 in PBS (PBST) 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes per wash)

**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, SCRI Renaissance 2200]
**Justification:** ClearSee is an aqueous-based clearing method specifically optimized for plant tissues, effectively removing chlorophyll and reducing scattering while preserving endogenous GFP fluorescence. **Protocol Steps:**
1 Clearing and Chlorophyll Removal
1.1 Incubation with ClearSee solution (10% w/v xylitol, 15% w/v sodium deoxycholate, 25% w/v urea in distilled water) in the dark. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4-7 days)
1.2 Replace with fresh ClearSee solution and continue incubation until the sample appears transparent (chlorophyll removed). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2-3 days)

2 Cell Wall Staining
2.1 Incubation with ClearSee solution containing 0.1% (v/v) SCRI Renaissance 2200. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2-3 days)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [alpha-bungarotoxin, Neurofilament+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** CUBIC is an aqueous, hydrophilic clearing method highly effective for dense, fibrous tissues like skeletal muscle while preserving endogenous fluorescence and minimizing tissue shrinkage or distortion, which is critical for analyzing NMJ morphology and spatial distribution. The use of alpha-bungarotoxin directly labels AChRs on the postsynaptic membrane with high specificity, and conjugating it to a far-red dye (e.g., Alexa Fluor 594) ensures deep tissue penetration. To visualize the presynaptic nerve terminals and axons, an antibody against Neurofilament (a structural component of the neuronal cytoskeleton) labeled with Alexa Fluor 647 is selected, providing a clear contrast to the postsynaptic marker for comprehensive NMJ analysis.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-R1)
1.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R1 solution (25 wt% urea, 25 wt% N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in distilled water) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3-5 days)
1.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-R1 solution and continue incubation with gentle shaking until the tissue becomes transparent. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1-2 days)

2 Washing
2.1 Rinse samples with 1x PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) to remove residual CUBIC-R1. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
2.2 Wash samples in 1x PBS with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, change solution every 30 minutes)

3 Immunolabeling and Staining
3.1 Permeabilization and blocking: Incubation with blocking buffer (0.5% Triton X-100, 5% normal donkey serum in 1x PBS) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Primary antibody incubation: Incubation with Anti-Neurofilament antibody (e.g., Rabbit anti-Neurofilament) diluted in blocking buffer (1:500) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3-5 days)
3.3 Wash samples with 0.5% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS (PBST) to remove unbound primary antibody. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, change solution every 4 hours)
3.4 Secondary antibody and toxin incubation: Incubation with Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and alpha-bungarotoxin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 594 (1:1000) diluted in blocking buffer with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3-5 days)
3.5 Wash samples with PBST to remove unbound secondary antibody and toxin. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, change solution every 4 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R2)
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R2 solution (50 wt% sucrose, 25 wt% urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in distilled water) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1-2 days)
4.2 Replace with fresh CUBIC-R2 solution and incubate until the sample sinks and RI is matched (RI ~1.48). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day)

5 Storage and Imaging
5.1 Store samples in fresh CUBIC-R2 solution at 4 ℃ protected from light until imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Long-term)

请根据该科学问题自行选择合适的荧光/标记策略，并匹配适合完整骨骼肌三维成像的组织透明方法。若限制范围内的 alpha-bungarotoxin 可直接标记突触后膜，应作为主标记；若 Phalloidin 可提供肌纤维 F-actin 结构参考，可作为辅助探针，但不能替代 NMJ 或神经末梢标记。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [alpha-bungarotoxin, Phalloidin, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with skeletal muscle tissue, providing high transparency while preserving endogenous fluorescence and allowing deep penetration of small molecule probes like alpha-bungarotoxin and Phalloidin. Its aqueous nature minimizes tissue shrinkage compared to organic solvent methods, which is critical for accurately analyzing the spatial relationship between NMJs and muscle fibers. The protocol is optimized for the sample size (8x5x3 mm) to ensure complete clearing and labeling.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) ethanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Permeabilization and Delipidation (CUBIC-L)
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% (wt/vol) urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in dH2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48-72 hours)

3 Washing
3.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, change solution every 2 hours)

4 Immunolabeling and Staining
4.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.2 Incubation with staining solution containing Alexa Fluor 488 conjugated alpha-bungarotoxin (1:1000), Alexa Fluor 594 conjugated Phalloidin (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000) in PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72-96 hours)

5 Washing
5.1 Incubation with PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, change solution every 4 hours)

6 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
6.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45% (wt/vol) urea, 30% (wt/vol) sucrose, 10% (wt/vol) 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in dH2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24-48 hours)

7 Storage and Imaging
7.1 Store sample in fresh CUBIC-R solution at 4 ℃ protected from light until imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Long-term)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 488, alpha-SMA+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** The iDISCO+ method is selected because it is highly effective for clearing dense, thick, and lipid-rich tissues like the stomach wall (containing muscle and mucosal layers) while preserving endogenous fluorescence and allowing deep immunolabeling. The methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation steps efficiently remove lipids from the multi-layered gastric tissue, rendering the whole stomach transparent. The labeling strategy uses PGP9.5 (a pan-neuronal marker) to comprehensively visualize the entire enteric nervous system (nerve fibers, branches, and terminals) and alpha-SMA to delineate the smooth muscle layers, allowing for the analysis of spatial relationships between nerves and muscle layers. DAPI provides nuclear context for structural orientation. This combination is ideal for high-resolution 3D mapping of neural density and complexity across different stomach regions.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Pre-treatment
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour to begin dehydration and permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol for 3 hours to remove lipids. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane for 15 minutes to wash away methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.25 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 2 washes, 20 minutes each, to rehydrate. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.33 hours)
1.9 Bleaching with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) overnight to reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.10 Rehydration through a methanol series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in PBS, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.11 Incubation with PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 1 hour to wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.12 Permeabilization with PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine for 24 hours to enhance antibody penetration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.13 Incubation with PBS with 0.2% Tween-20, 10ug/ml Heparin, 5% DMSO (PTwH) for 1 hour to wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Blocking and primary antibody incubation: Incubate with PTwH containing Rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500), Mouse anti-alpha-SMA (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000) for 14 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 336 hours)
2.2 Wash with PTwH for 1 day, changing solution 3-5 times to remove unbound primary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Secondary antibody incubation: Incubate with PTwH containing Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Mouse Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) for 14 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 336 hours)
2.4 Wash with PTwH for 1 day, changing solution 3-5 times to remove unbound secondary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Clearing and Refractive Index Matching
3.1 Dehydration through a methanol series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% methanol in distilled water, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 2 hours to ensure complete dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol for 3 hours to delipidate. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane for 15 minutes to wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.25 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) for RI matching and final clearing until transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 488, TH+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** The iDISCO+ method is selected for its superior ability to handle large, dense, and lipid-rich organs like the stomach (20 mm size) while preserving fine neuronal architecture. It utilizes a methanol dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation strategy that effectively clears the thick muscular and mucosal layers of the stomach wall, allowing for deep light-sheet imaging. The labeling strategy employs PGP9.5 (a pan-neuronal marker) to comprehensively outline the entire enteric nervous system and vagal innervation, and TH (Tyrosine Hydroxylase) to specifically highlight sympathetic/adrenergic fibers, enabling the comparison of different neural networks. DAPI is included as a structural reference for nuclei and tissue layers. iDISCO+ is highly compatible with immunolabeling using these antibodies and provides excellent tissue shrinkage uniformity, which is critical for establishing a standardized 3D atlas.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Pre-treatment and Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 100% Methanol (MeOH) for 1 hour to remove water and begin fixation stabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 80% MeOH / 20% ddH2O for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 40% MeOH / 60% ddH2O for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 20% MeOH / 80% ddH2O for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Wash with PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Bleaching and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with 6% H2O2 in PBS to quench autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBTx) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100 / 20% DMSO / 0.3M Glycine in PBS for permeabilization and aldehyde quenching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.4 Wash with PBTx for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 5% Normal Donkey Serum, 0.01% Sodium Azide in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with Primary Antibodies: Rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500) and Chicken anti-TH (1:500) diluted in Antibody Diluent (0.2% Tween-20, 5% Normal Donkey Serum, 0.01% Sodium Azide in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.3 Wash with PBTx for 1 day, changing solution 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) diluted in Antibody Diluent. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.5 Wash with PBTx for 1 day, changing solution 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Nuclear Counterstaining
4.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS) for nuclear staining. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Wash with PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

5 Dehydration
5.1 Incubation with 20% MeOH / 80% ddH2O for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 40% MeOH / 60% ddH2O for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.3 Incubation with 60% MeOH / 40% ddH2O for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.4 Incubation with 80% MeOH / 20% ddH2O for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.5 Incubation with 100% MeOH for 1 hour, repeat twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

6 Delipidation and Clearing
6.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM) for lipid removal. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
6.2 Incubation with 100% MeOH for 30 minutes to wash out DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

7 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
7.1 Incubation with 100% dibenzyl ether (DBE) for refractive index matching and final clearing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

请根据该科学问题自行选择合适的荧光/标记策略，并基于所选标记样本选择匹配的组织透明方法。若已有 EGFP 与 tdTomato 内源荧光报告信号可以直接完成投射神经元和轴突示踪，应优先保留该信号，不应额外选择抗体替代同一主示踪目标。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [EGFP, tdTomato]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected because it is specifically optimized for preserving and enhancing endogenous fluorescent proteins like EGFP and tdTomato in large tissues (whole mouse brain) while achieving high transparency and significant tissue shrinkage (which aids in faster imaging). The problem requires tracking long-range axons and comparing spatial overlaps; uDISCO's superior fluorescence retention for these specific proteins and its compatibility with light-sheet microscopy make it ideal for mapping the amygdala-prefrontal-thalamus-nucleus accumbens circuits without the need for additional antibody staining.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) (first wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) (second wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Delipidation and Decolorization
2.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

3 Refractive Index Matching
3.1 Incubation with BABB-D (Benzyl Alcohol/Benzyl Benzoate with Diphenyl Ether, RI ~1.56). (Temperature: RT, Time: Until transparent, typically 2-3 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [EGFP, tdTomato, MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it is a robust, methanol-based organic clearing method specifically optimized for whole mouse brains (10 mm scale) to achieve high transparency and deep antibody penetration. It addresses the previous failure with SWITCH (which resulted in turbidity) by utilizing a graded methanol dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation step that effectively removes lipids. This method is well-documented for preserving endogenous fluorescent proteins like EGFP and tdTomato when combined with specific bleaching and quenching steps, and it provides excellent conditions for immunolabeling with far-red antibodies (e.g., Alexa Fluor 647) to visualize the dendritic skeleton (MAP2) with low background, ensuring high-quality 3D imaging of long-range neural circuits.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to quench autofluorescence.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.7 Wash with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour to remove residual H2O2.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Rehydration and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (with 0.2% Triton X-100) for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (with 0.2% Triton X-100) for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (with 0.2% Triton X-100) for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (with 0.2% Triton X-100) for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.5 Wash with PBS (with 0.2% Triton X-100) for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.6 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS for 24 hours to permeabilize the tissue.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Immunolabeling (Dendritic Skeleton)
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution (5% normal donkey serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 24 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody against MAP2 (e.g., Rabbit anti-MAP2) diluted 1:500 in blocking solution for 7 days with gentle shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 168 hours)
3.3 Wash with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS for 24 hours (change solution 3-4 times).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.4 Incubation with secondary antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (e.g., Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647) diluted 1:500 in blocking solution for 7 days with gentle shaking protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 168 hours)
3.5 Wash with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS for 24 hours (change solution 3-4 times) protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol aqueous solution for 1 hour protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

5 Delipidation and Clearing
5.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM) for 30 minutes to delipidate the tissue protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
5.2 Incubation with fresh Dichloromethane (DCM) for 30 minutes protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
5.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 5 minutes to wash out DCM protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 0.08 hours)

6 Refractive Index Matching
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) until the tissue is transparent (approx. 15-30 minutes) protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
6.2 Transfer to fresh 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) for storage and imaging protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: Until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [C-FoS, Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to handle large, heterogeneous tissue samples (whole brain and tongue) simultaneously, providing excellent transparency and lipid removal while preserving endogenous fluorescence or immunolabeling. The methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation steps are robust for dense muscle tissue like the tongue. The protocol is optimized for immunolabeling deep into tissues, which is essential for detecting the low-abundance immediate early gene C-FoS (activation marker) throughout the whole brain. Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 are chosen for their brightness and stability during the clearing process, while DAPI provides a nuclear counterstain for anatomical reference of the tongue muscle fibers and brain structure.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-Fixation and Washing
1.1 Incubation with PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) to wash samples. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS for post-fixation. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.3 Incubation with PBS to wash samples. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Methanol Dehydration
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Bleaching
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in Methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes Methanol). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

4 Rehydration
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Incubation with PBS (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5 Permeabilization
5.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS with 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS with 10% DMSO, 0.2M Glycine. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.3 Incubation with PTw (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

11 Refractive Index Matching

**Protocol Steps:**

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST (0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to bleach pigments and autofluorescence.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.7 Wash with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour to remove residual H2O2.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Rehydration and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in 0.1% PBST for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.5 Wash with 0.1% PBST for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.6 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS (0.2% PBST) for 24 hours to permeabilize tissue.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.7 Wash with 0.1% PBST for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% Gelatin, 0.5% Triton X-100, 0.05% Sodium Azide in PBS) for 24 hours at 37°C to block non-specific binding.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibodies (Rabbit anti-c-Fos, Goat anti-Npas4) diluted in blocking solution (1:500 - 1:1000) for 7 days at 37°C with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour, repeat twice.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO is specifically optimized for large, intact tissue samples (such as the 3 cm spinal cord and brain blocks) and provides superior transparency with minimal shrinkage compared to other methods. It is highly compatible with lipophilic carbocyanine dyes (DiI, DiD) and preserves their fluorescence effectively during the dehydration and clearing process. Since the scientific goal relies on tracing lipophilic dye-labeled pathways, no antibody staining is required, and DAPI serves as a nuclear counterstain for structural registration. The final high refractive index (RI ~1.56) allows for deep light-sheet imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-Fixation and Pre-Treatment
1.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS to ensure fixation stability. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS to remove excess PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water for dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 40% (wt/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water for dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 60% (wt/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water for dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 80% (wt/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water for dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (wt/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) for delipidation and dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.8 Incubation with fresh 100% (wt/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) for delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Decolorization (Optional but recommended for spinal cord)
2.1 Incubation with 5% (wt/vol) Aminoalcohol (BABB without DBE) or 5% H2O2 in THF (if compatible with dyes, otherwise skip) to reduce pigmentation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM) for final delipidation and solvent exchange. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.2 Incubation with a mixture of 47% (wt/vol) Benzyl Alcohol and 53% (wt/vol) Benzyl Benzoate (BABB) for RI matching and clearing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes to 1 hour until transparent)

4 Storage and Imaging
4.1 Store samples in fresh BABB solution in the dark at room temperature until imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Long-term)

**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD, DAPI]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its superior capability to achieve high transparency and significant volume reduction (up to 65%) in large, dense tissues like the whole spinal cord and brain, which is critical for deep imaging of long ascending pathways. It preserves lipophilic tracer signals (DiI, DiD) exceptionally well while quenching autofluorescence, thereby maximizing the signal-to-noise ratio for mapping fine axonal projections. The method is relatively fast and results in a high refractive index (RI ~1.51), making it ideal for light-sheet microscopy to reconstruct the 3D spatial relationships between the spinal entry points, thalamic relays, and cortical terminals. DAPI is included as a nuclear counterstain to assist in anatomical registration of thalamic nuclei and cortical layers without interfering with the lipophilic pathway tracers.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with fresh 5% (vol/vol) Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2) in Methanol (prepared by mixing 1 part 30% H2O2 with 5 parts Methanol). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

3 Rehydration

3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

4 Nuclear Counterstaining
4.1 Incubation with DAPI solution in PBS (1:1000 dilution from stock). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 488, CGRP+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** The sample is a lipid-rich 1 cm³ subcutaneous white adipose tissue (scWAT) block. uDISCO is selected because it is specifically optimized for delipidating and clearing fatty tissues efficiently while shrinking the sample to facilitate deep imaging. The method uses organic solvents (tert-Butanol and DCM) which effectively remove lipids to prevent RI mismatch and scattering. The labeling strategy uses PGP9.5 as a pan-neuronal marker to visualize the general nerve network and CGRP (Calcitonin Gene-Related Peptide) as a specific marker for sensory nerve fibers, allowing the user to distinguish sensory innervation from the total network. DAPI is included for nuclear counterstaining to visualize tissue structure. uDISCO preserves these fluorescent signals well and matches the RI to ~1.56, ideal for deep light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration and Permeabilization
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat twice)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Rehydration: Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Rehydration: Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Rehydration: Incubation with PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Blocking: Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 0.1% (wt/vol) Sodium Azide, 5% (vol/vol) Normal Donkey Serum, and 20% (vol/vol) DMSO. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.5 Primary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with blocking solution containing Rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500) and Goat anti-CGRP (1:500). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 120 hours)
2.6 Wash: Incubation with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution every 8 hours)
2.7 Secondary Antibody Incubation: Incubation with blocking solution containing Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Goat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and DAPI (1:1000). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 96 hours)
2.8 Wash: Incubation with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution every 8 hours)

3 Optical Clearing and RI Matching
3.1 Dehydration: Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Dehydration: Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Dehydration: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Delipidation: Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM) in Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.5 Delipidation: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat twice)
3.6 RI Matching: Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) tert-Butanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)
3.7 RI Matching: Incubation with BABB-D4 (Mixture of Benzyl Alcohol, Benzyl Benzoate, and Diphenyl Ether, RI ~1.56). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours until transparent)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5, CGRP, Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** The iDISCO+ protocol is selected because it utilizes a graded methanol dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation sequence, which is highly effective for removing lipids from high-fat tissues like scWAT that failed to clear with the aqueous CUBIC reagents. This method ensures complete tissue transparency (RI ~1.56) necessary for deep 3D imaging of nerve fibers. The immunolabeling strategy targets PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal marker) and CGRP (sensory neuron marker) using Alexa Fluor 488 and 647, respectively. These dyes are retained well in organic solvents and provide high signal-to-noise ratio for quantifying fiber density and spatial distribution within the adipose tissue architecture.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with Methanol 50% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with Methanol 100% (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)
1.4 Incubation with chilled fresh 6% H2O2 in Methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 4 volumes Methanol). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.5 Wash with Methanol 100% (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)

2 Rehydration and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in dH2O with 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with Methanol 50% (vol/vol) in dH2O with 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with PBS 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with PBS 0.2% Triton X-100 + 20% DMSO + 0.3M Glycine. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with PBS 0.2% Triton X-100 + 10% DMSO + 0.2% Tween-20. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution (PBS 0.2% Tween-20 + 5% Normal Donkey Serum + 5% DMSO). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.2 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution (Anti-PGP9.5, Anti-CGRP diluted in PBS 0.2% Tween-20 + 5% Normal Donkey Serum + 5% DMSO). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 days)
3.3 Wash with PBS 0.2% Tween-20 + 1% DMSO. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3 times)
3.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution (Alexa Fluor 488 anti-Rabbit, Alexa Fluor 647 anti-Goat diluted in PBS 0.2% Tween-20 + 5% Normal Donkey Serum + 5% DMSO). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 days)
3.5 Wash with PBS 0.2% Tween-20 + 1% DMSO. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3 times)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with Methanol 20% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.2 Incubation with Methanol 40% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.3 Incubation with Methanol 60% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.4 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.5 Incubation with Methanol 100% (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, repeat twice)

5 Delipidation and Clearing
5.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes, repeat twice)
5.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 minutes)

6 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, until tissue is transparent)

The labeling strategy uses anti-CGRP to specifically identify sensory nerve fibers, anti-PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal marker) to visualize the general neural network, and DAPI for nuclear counterstaining of bone marrow and meningeal cells. This combination directly addresses the scientific goal of analyzing the 3D distribution and density of sensory versus general nerves in bone and meninges.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with Decalcification Solution (0.5 M EDTA, pH 7.4) at 37°C with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

1.3 Incubation with Decolorization/Decalcification Solution (8% w/v SDS, 0.2 M boric acid, pH 7.4) at 37°C with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)

2.2 Incubation with Blocking Solution (6% Donkey Serum, 0.1% Triton X-100, 0.02% Sodium Azide in PBS) at 37°C with shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

请根据该科学问题自行选择合适的荧光/标记策略，并匹配适合骨组织、骨髓和脑膜复合样本的透明方法。若限制范围内的 Lectin 或 IB4 可以直接标记血管腔面，应作为血管辅助通道；神经纤维身份仍需由表内神经相关靶点完成。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5 (Pan-neuronal), CGRP (Sensory fibers), Lectin (Vessels), DAPI (Nuclei)]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected because it is highly effective for clearing dense, calcified tissues like bone and skull after decalcification, while preserving protein epitopes for immunolabeling. Its methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation steps efficiently remove lipids from bone marrow and meninges, rendering the complex bone-meningeal composite transparent. The method is compatible with light-sheet microscopy, which is essential for establishing 3D spatial relationships between nerves, vessels, and bone structures. The labeling strategy targets PGP9.5 for pan-neural fibers, CGRP for specific sensory fibers, and Lectin to visualize the vascular lumen, fulfilling the requirement to map neural paths relative to vascular channels and bone foramina.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Sample Preparation and Decalcification
1.1 Rinse fixed samples (Skull, Femur, Marrow, Meninges) in 1x PBS to remove residual PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Decalcify samples in 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.4) with gentle shaking. Change solution every 2 days. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7-14 days)
1.3 Wash samples in 1x PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBT) to remove EDTA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Bleaching
2.1 Incubate samples in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBT. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubate samples in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBT. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubate samples in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBT. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubate samples in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBT. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubate samples in 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Bleach samples in chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12-16 hours)
2.7 Rehydrate samples through a methanol gradient: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in PBT, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
2.8 Wash samples in PBT. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Permeabilize samples in 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.2 Block and permeabilize samples in 0.2% Tween-20, 10% DMSO, 6% Donkey Serum in PBS (Blocking Solution). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.3 Incubate with primary antibodies diluted in Blocking Solution: Rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500), Goat anti-CGRP (1:500), and Dylight 649 or Alexa Fluor 647 conjugated Lectin (1:200). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5-7 days)
3.4 Wash samples in PBT with 0.2% Tween-20 (PTw) for 1 day, changing solution 3-5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.5 Incubate with secondary antibodies (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488, Donkey anti-Goat Alexa Fluor 555) diluted 1:500 in Blocking Solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5-7 days)
3.6 Wash samples in PTw for 1 day, changing solution 3-5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Nuclear Counterstaining
4.1 Incubate samples in DAPI solution (1 µg/mL in PBS) to stain nuclei. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Wash samples in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

5 Dehydration
5.1 Incubate samples in 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.2 Incubate samples in 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.3 Incubate samples in 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.4 Incubate samples in 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.5 Incubate samples in 100% (vol/vol) methanol (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)

6 Delipidation and Clearing
6.1 Incubate samples in Dichloromethane (DCM) for delipidation (twice). (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes each)
6.2 Incubate samples in 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 minutes)

7 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
7.1 Incubate samples in 100% (vol/vol) DBE (Dibenzyl Ether) until transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12-24 hours)
7.2 Store samples in fresh DBE at 4°C protected from light until imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Long-term)

specific_question:
我需要对小鼠颅骨、股骨、骨髓和脑膜进行透明化处理，用于研究 CNS 与 PNS 通过骨组织的解剖连接。样本包括约 1.5 cm × 1 cm × 0.5 mm 的颅骨、约 1.5 cm 长的股骨，以及骨髓和脑膜结构，已完成固定和后固定。科学目标是同时标记骨组织中的 CGRP 阳性感觉神经纤维和泛神经纤维网络，或者在解剖连接分析中显示骨内/脑膜泛神经纤维和较粗大轴突结构，比较神经纤维在骨缝、骨孔、骨髓腔、脑膜界面和长骨内部的空间分布。

我在进行小鼠颅骨透明化实验时遇到问题：按照标准 BoneClear protocol 操作，固定后进行甲醇梯度脱水和 bleaching，然后进行远红荧光二抗孵育和 RI matching。结果骨组织仍然不透明，无法观察骨内结构，且远红信号很弱。该流程可能缺少充分脱钙、骨基质软化、深层透化和长时间抗体渗透，也可能因 bleaching 或脱水步骤过强导致抗原和荧光信号受损。请根据上述科学目标，在不引入给定标记物列表之外靶点或表外荧光团的前提下，重新选择或调整荧光/标记策略与组织透明方法。修正版应适合矿化骨组织脱钙、骨髓和脑膜结构保留、神经纤维双信号检测、低背景、深层抗体渗透和三维成像。

请仅输出修正后的 protocol，第 1 行写明应保留或更换的荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 488, CGRP+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to clear highly mineralized bone tissues (skull and femur) after decalcification and its compatibility with deep immunolabeling. The methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation steps effectively remove lipids and residual bone matrix components, rendering the samples transparent for 3D imaging. The protocol includes a critical decalcification step (EDTA) to soften the bone matrix and a gentle bleaching step to reduce autofluorescence without compromising antigenicity. The chosen labeling strategy targets PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal marker) and CGRP (sensory nerve marker) to visualize the general nerve network and specific sensory fibers, respectively, while DAPI stains nuclei for anatomical context. This combination addresses the scientific goal of mapping CNS-PNS connections through bone structures.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.4) in PBS, shaking gently. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 days, change solution daily)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS for 1 hour to remove residual EDTA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2 Dehydration
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)

3 Bleaching
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.2 Wash with 100% methanol for 1 hour to remove H2O2. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)

4 Rehydration
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
4.5 Wash with 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

5 Permeabilization
5.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 0.2M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Blocking
6.1 Incubation with 6% Donkey Serum, 0.2% Triton X-100, 5% DMSO in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

7 Primary Antibody Incubation
7.1 Incubation with Rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500) and Goat anti-CGRP (1:500) in blocking solution (6% Donkey Serum, 0.2% Triton X-100, 5% DMSO in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, shaking gently)

8 Wash
8.1 Wash with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3-4 times)

9 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining Incubation
9.1 Incubation with Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), Donkey anti-Goat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, shaking gently, protect from light)

10 Wash
10.1 Wash with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, change solution 3-4 times, protect from light)

11 Delipidation
11.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
11.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) DCM in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
11.3 Incubation with 100% DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat twice)

12 Refractive Index Matching
12.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, until transparent, protect from light)

**Chosen Method:** BoneClear
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH+Alexa Fluor 488, VIP+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 555]
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically optimized for decalcified bone tissues, offering excellent transparency for long bones (femur, tibia) and flat bones (skull) while preserving fine fluorescence signals. It effectively removes bone matrix residues that scatter light, which is critical for visualizing deep marrow structures. The labeling strategy targets Tyrosine Hydroxylase (TH) for catecholaminergic fibers and Vasoactive Intestinal Peptide (VIP) for peptidergic fibers, directly addressing the scientific goal of comparing sympathetic subtypes. Lectin provides a robust vascular reference, and DAPI stains nuclei for spatial context, allowing for quantitative analysis of nerve density, branching, and proximity to vasculature and endosteum.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.4) for 7 days. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.2 Rinse with 1x PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Delipidation
2.1 Incubation with BoneClear Solution A (20 wt/vol% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 25 wt/vol% Urea, 15 wt/vol% Triton X-100 in H2O) for 3 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
2.2 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Buffer (5% Donkey Serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBST) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with Primary Antibodies (Rabbit anti-TH, Goat anti-VIP) diluted in Antibody Dilution Buffer (3% Donkey Serum, 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBST) for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.3 Wash with PBST for 24 hours, changing solution every 8 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488, Donkey anti-Goat Alexa Fluor 647) and Lectin (Alexa Fluor 555 conjugate) diluted in Antibody Dilution Buffer for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.5 Wash with PBST for 24 hours, changing solution every 8 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.6 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBST) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.7 Wash with PBST for 12 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
4.1 Incubation with BoneClear Solution B (88 wt/vol% Histodenz, 0.5% Tween-20 in 0.02 M PBS, RI = 1.48) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Incubation with BoneClear Solution B for an additional 24 hours to ensure complete RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with Decalcification Solution (0.5 M EDTA, pH 7.4) at 37°C with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

1.3 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) Sucrose in 1x PBS for cryoprotection. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 1:1 mixture of 20% Sucrose and OCT compound. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.5 Embedding in OCT compound and freezing at -80°C. (Temperature: -80 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
1.6 Sectioning bone into 100-200 μm thick slices using a cryostat. (Temperature: -20 ℃, Time: Variable)
1.7 Permeabilization with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

2 Immunostaining
2.1 Blocking with Blocking Solution (5% Donkey Serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Primary Antibodies (Rabbit anti-TH, Goat anti-NPY) diluted in Antibody Diluent (3% Donkey Serum, 0.3% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.3 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours per wash)
2.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488, Donkey anti-Goat Alexa Fluor 647) and DAPI (1 μg/mL) diluted in Antibody Diluent. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.5 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours per wash)

3 Optical Clearing and RI Matching
3.1 Dehydration with graded Methanol series: 50%, 80%, 100% (twice) in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per step)
3.2 Delipidation with 66% Dichloromethane in Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.3 Clearing and RI Matching with 100% Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
3.4 Final RI Matching with dibenzyl ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
