**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Tuj1 (β-III Tubulin)+Alexa Fluor 488, Pan-Cytokeratin+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** The iDISCO+ method is selected because it is highly effective for clearing large, dense, and lipid-rich tissues like pancreatic tumors (12 mm size) while preserving endogenous fluorescence and allowing deep immunolabeling. The methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation steps efficiently remove the complex fibrous stroma and necrotic debris characteristic of pancreatic cancer, rendering the tissue transparent. The labeling strategy uses Tuj1 to visualize the detailed neural architecture (axons, branches) and Pan-Cytokeratin to delineate the tumor epithelial boundaries, enabling the analysis of perineural invasion (PNI) and spatial relationships between nerves and tumor cells. DAPI provides nuclear context for the overall tissue structure.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with Methanol 20% (vol/vol) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with Methanol 40% (vol/vol) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with Methanol 60% (vol/vol) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% Methanol (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.6 Incubation with 100% Methanol (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.7 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in Methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.8 Wash with 100% Methanol (vol/vol) twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)

2 Rehydration and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.2 Incubation with Methanol 60% (vol/vol) in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.3 Incubation with Methanol 40% (vol/vol) in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.4 Incubation with Methanol 20% (vol/vol) in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.5 Wash with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
2.6 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% Donkey Serum in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with Primary Antibodies: Rabbit anti-Tuj1 (1:500) and Chicken anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (1:500) in antibody diluent (0.2% Tween-20, 5% DMSO, 3% Donkey Serum in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.3 Wash with PBST (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS) for 1 day, changing solution 3-5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in antibody diluent. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.5 Wash with PBST (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS) for 1 day, changing solution 3-5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.6 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBST. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with Methanol 20% (vol/vol) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.2 Incubation with Methanol 40% (vol/vol) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.3 Incubation with Methanol 60% (vol/vol) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.4 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
4.5 Incubation with 100% Methanol (vol/vol) twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)

5 Delipidation and Clearing
5.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM) twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes per wash)
5.2 Incubation with 100% Methanol (vol/vol). (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 minutes)

6 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) until tissue is transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours to 24 hours)

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Pre-treatment
1.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 1 hour to permeabilize the tissue. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol overnight to ensure complete dehydration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.8 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to bleach autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.9 Wash twice with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour each to remove residual H2O2. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.10 Rehydration series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in distilled water, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.11 Wash with PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 0.3M Glycine, 20% DMSO in PBS) for 24 hours to enhance antibody penetration. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% Donkey Serum in PBS) for 24 hours at 37 ℃ to block non-specific binding. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Incubation with primary antibody solution containing Rabbit anti-TH (1:500), Chicken anti-PGP9.5 (1:500), and Mouse anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (1:500) in antibody diluent (0.2% Tween-20, 5% DMSO, 3% Donkey Serum in PBS) for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)
2.4 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20 (PTw) for 1 day, changing solution at least 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.5 Incubation with secondary antibody solution containing Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 568, Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 488, and Donkey anti-Mouse Alexa Fluor 647 (all 1:500) in antibody diluent for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)
2.6 Wash with PTw for 1 day, changing solution at least 5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Clearing and Delipidation
3.1 Dehydration series: Incubate with 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 hours)
3.2 Incubate with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 2 hours to ensure complete dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.3 Incubate with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol for 3 hours to begin delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.4 Incubate with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for 15 minutes to remove lipids, repeated twice with fresh solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
3.5 Incubate with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) for refractive index matching until the tissue is transparent (approx. 15-30 minutes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

4.2 Wash with 100% (vol/vol) DBE for 1 hour to remove unbound DAPI. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

我在进行胰腺肿瘤神经浸润研究时发现，神经纤维标记信号很弱，且肿瘤与正常组织边界不清晰。此前使用 PEGASOS protocol，但 delipidation 只进行了 24 小时，并且没有进行 decoloration 步骤。请根据上述科学目标，在不引入给定标记物列表之外靶点或表外荧光团的前提下，重新选择或调整荧光/标记策略与组织透明方法。修正版应适合胰腺肿瘤组织的充分脱脂、脱色/降背景、深层抗体渗透、泛神经与交感神经双信号检测、肿瘤边界辅助判读和三维 PNI 分析。

请仅输出修正后的 protocol，第 1 行写明应保留或更换的荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 488, TH+Alexa Fluor 647, Pan-Cytokeratin+Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior delipidation and decolorization capabilities via graded methanol and dichloromethane treatments, which are critical for the 12 mm pancreatic tumor to address the weak nerve signals and high background autofluorescence mentioned. The protocol includes a bleaching step to enhance contrast. The labeling strategy uses PGP9.5 for pan-neural fibers, TH for sympathetic fibers, and Pan-Cytokeratin to clearly delineate tumor boundaries and epithelial cells, enabling precise analysis of perineural invasion (PNI) and neural remodeling in 3D.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration and Decolorization
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
1.5 Incubation with fresh 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane in Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, repeat twice)
1.7 Incubation with 5% (vol/vol) H2O2 in Methanol (prepared fresh). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat twice)

2 Rehydration and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.5 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 20% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.6 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 6% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Primary Antibodies: Rabbit anti-PGP9.5 (1:500), Chicken anti-TH (1:500), Mouse anti-Pan-Cytokeratin (1:500) in 0.2% Tween-20, 5% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum, 0.01% Sodium Azide in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 14 days)
3.2 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution 3 times)
3.3 Incubation with Secondary Antibodies: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), Donkey anti-Mouse Alexa Fluor 555 (1:500) and DAPI (1:1000) in 0.2% Tween-20, 5% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum in PBS. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 14 days)
3.4 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution 3 times)

4 Delipidation and Clearing
4.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
4.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.5 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane in Methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
4.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dichloromethane. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat twice)

5 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
5.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, until transparent)
5.2 Storage and Imaging in 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE). (Temperature: RT)

**Justification:** The iDISCO+ method is selected for its superior clearing capability on dense, lipid-rich tumor tissues and its compatibility with immunolabeling, which is essential for distinguishing total vasculature (CD31) from perfused vasculature (Lectin). This method allows for high-resolution 3D reconstruction of vascular networks and precise analysis of tumor microenvironments, including core and invasive margins.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Perfusion Labeling (Optional but recommended for perfusion status)
1.1 Intracardiac perfusion with 100 µg/mL Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated Lectin in PBS, followed by 4% PFA fixation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes perfusion)
2 Post-fixation and Washing
2.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 3 times)
3 Methanol Dehydration
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 2 times)
4 Bleaching
4.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
5 Rehydration
5.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.5 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6 Permeabilization
6.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.2 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
6.3 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 0.2M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
7 Blocking
7.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20, 5% normal donkey serum, 0.01% sodium azide. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
8 Immunolabeling
8.1 Incubation with primary antibody Rat anti-mouse CD31 (1:500) in PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20, 3% normal donkey serum, 0.01% sodium azide. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
8.2 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 5 times)
8.3 Incubation with secondary antibody Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20, 3% normal donkey serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)

9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour, repeat 2 times)
10 Delipidation and Clearing
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes, repeat 2 times)
11 Refractive Index Matching

**Chosen Method:** uDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato, Pan-Cytokeratin+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** uDISCO is selected for its superior ability to rapidly clear whole mouse brains (12 mm size) to near transparency while preserving endogenous red fluorescent proteins like tdTomato/RFP exceptionally well. Pan-Cytokeratin conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 is chosen to validate the epithelial identity of the tumor cells; Alexa Fluor 647 is compatible with the organic solvents used in uDISCO and provides a spectrally distinct channel from tdTomato.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Dehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

2 Delipidation and Decolorization
2.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

3 Rehydration for Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.3 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
3.4 Incubation with PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) with 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4 Immunolabeling
4.1 Incubation with Blocking Solution (5% DMSO, 10% Goat Serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.2 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution (Pan-Cytokeratin antibody diluted 1:500 in Permeabilization Solution: 0.2% Triton X-100, 3% DMSO, 5% Goat Serum in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
4.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution 3 times)
4.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution (Goat anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 diluted 1:500 in Permeabilization Solution). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
4.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution 3 times)

5 Dehydration for Clearing
5.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.3 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)
5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Tetrahydrofuran (THF) in dH2O. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
6.1 Incubation with BABB-D (Benzyl Alcohol/Benzyl Benzoate with Diphenyl Ether, RI ~1.56). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes to 1 hour, until transparent)

请根据该科学问题自行选择合适的荧光/标记策略，并基于所选标记样本选择匹配的组织透明方法。若直接示踪染料只能显示神经路径而不能区分感觉神经和交感神经身份，则不应替代 CGRP 或 TH 主标记。请仅输出 protocol，第 1 行写明所选荧光/标记策略和组织透明方法，随后仅列出透明处理、RI 匹配和保存/成像前处理步骤的关键试剂、条件和时间。

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** BoneClear
**Chosen Labeling:** [CGRP+Alexa Fluor 488, TH+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically optimized for mineralized hard tissues like bone, addressing the critical need for effective decalcification and delipidation while preserving fluorescence. It allows for deep antibody penetration into the marrow cavity and bone matrix, which is essential for visualizing the 3D distribution of sensory (CGRP) and sympathetic (TH) nerve fibers. The method maintains tissue morphology and is compatible with light-sheet microscopy, enabling the analysis of nerve density and branching in the bone microenvironment.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification and Delipidation
1.1 Incubation with Decalcification Buffer (0.5 M EDTA, pH 7.4) at 37°C with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) 3 times to remove EDTA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.3 Incubation with BoneClear Delipidation Solution (20 wt/vol% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine in 1x PBS) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 days)

2 Permeabilization and Washing
2.1 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) to remove residual delipidation solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Permeabilization Buffer (0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in 1x PBS) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Buffer (6% Donkey Serum, 5% DMSO, 0.2% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution (Rabbit anti-CGRP 1:500, Chicken anti-TH 1:500 in Blocking Buffer) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 10 days)
3.3 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20 (PBST) 3 times to remove unbound primary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.4 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 1:500, Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 647 1:500, DAPI 1:1000 in Blocking Buffer) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 10 days)
3.5 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.2% Tween-20 (PBST) 3 times to remove unbound secondary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
4.1 Incubation with BoneClear RIMS (Refractive Index Matching Solution: 88 wt/vol% Histodenz in 0.02M PBS, pH 7.4, RI = 1.46) with gentle shaking until sample becomes transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Transfer to fresh BoneClear RIMS for final RI matching and storage before imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** BoneClear
**Chosen Labeling:** [CGRP+Alexa Fluor 488, PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI, Lectin (Alexa Fluor 594)]
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically optimized for decalcified hard tissues like bone, allowing deep penetration of antibodies and high transparency while preserving fine neuronal structures. It effectively removes lipids and matches the refractive index to minimize scattering, which is critical for imaging the dense cortical and trabecular bone of the femur. The labeling strategy uses CGRP (Calcitonin Gene-Related Peptide) to specifically identify sensory nerve fibers, PGP9.5 as a pan-neuronal marker to visualize the entire neural network, Lectin to label blood vessels for spatial reference, and DAPI for nuclear morphology. This combination directly addresses the scientific goal of comparing the distribution and remodeling of sensory fibers against the general nerve network and vasculature in 3D.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Decalcification
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.4) for 7 days. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 days)
1.2 Rinse with 1x PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Delipidation
2.1 Incubation with BoneClear Solution A (20% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 10% (wt/vol) Triton X-100, 5% (wt/vol) urea in distilled water) for 3 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)
2.2 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

3 Blocking
3.1 Incubation with Blocking Buffer (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.5% (wt/vol) bovine serum albumin, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) for 2 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days)

4 Immunostaining
4.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution (Rabbit anti-CGRP 1:200, Chicken anti-PGP9.5 1:500, Alexa Fluor 594 conjugated Lectin 1:100 in Blocking Buffer) for 7 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
4.2 Wash with PBST for 12 hours (change solution every 4 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.3 Incubation with Secondary Antibody Solution (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 1:500, Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 647 1:500 in Blocking Buffer) for 5 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days)
4.4 Wash with PBST for 12 hours (change solution every 4 hours). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5 Nuclear Counterstaining
5.1 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5.2 Wash with 1x PBS for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

6 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing
6.1 Incubation with BoneClear Solution B (88% (wt/vol) Histodenz, 0.5% (wt/vol) Naphthol Green B in 0.02 M phosphate buffer, pH 7.5) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
6.2 Transfer to fresh BoneClear Solution B for storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: Until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** BoneClear  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CGRP+Alexa Fluor 488, TH+Alexa Fluor 647, PGP9.5+Alexa Fluor 555, DAPI]  
**Justification:** BoneClear is specifically optimized for mineralized bone tissues, combining efficient decalcification with delipidation and RI matching to achieve high transparency while preserving fine structures like nerve fibers. The protocol integrates EDTA decalcification (essential for antibody penetration into the marrow cavity) and detergent-based clearing, which is critical for deep immunolabeling of CGRP and TH in dense bone. The selected markers (CGRP for sensory nerves, TH for sympathetic nerves, PGP9.5 for pan-neuronal networks, and DAPI for nuclei) cover the scientific goals of analyzing nerve density and distribution in bone cancer pain models. The method ensures low background and compatibility with 3D imaging.  

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Decalcification  
1.1 Incubation with 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.4) in PBS, refreshed daily. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 7–10 days)  
1.2 Rinse with PBS 3 times, 30 minutes each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1.5 hours)  

2 Permeabilization and Delipidation  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (wt/vol) sucrose in PBS. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with 6% (wt/vol) SDS in 0.1 M phosphate buffer (pH 7.4). (Temperature: 37°C, Time: 48–72 hours)  

3 Immunolabeling  
3.1 Blocking with 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
3.2 Primary antibody incubation: anti-CGRP (1:500), anti-TH (1:500), anti-PGP9.5 (1:1000) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 7 days)  
3.3 Wash with PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 3 times, 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
3.4 Secondary antibody incubation: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-rabbit (1:500), Alexa Fluor 647 anti-mouse (1:500), Alexa Fluor 555 anti-chicken (1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 7 days)  
3.5 Wash with PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 3 times, 2 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
3.6 Nuclear staining with DAPI (1 µg/mL) in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

4 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing  
4.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) glycerol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) glycerol + 0.1% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
4.3 Final RI matching with 100% (vol/vol) glycerol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Imaging Preparation  
5.1 Mount sample in glycerol in a quartz dish or imaging chamber. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato, Sox10+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with fluorescent proteins (tdTomato) and high transparency in small tissue blocks like E9.5–E10.5 mouse embryos. Its aqueous, alkaline nature preserves tissue morphology better than organic solvents (like uDISCO/iDISCO+) for delicate embryonic structures, and it allows for effective nuclear staining (DAPI) to aid in 3D registration and cell density analysis. The protocol is relatively fast and gentle, suitable for maintaining the spatial relationships of neural crest cells.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
1.3 Incubation with 100% PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution (0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.1% (wt/vol) NaN3, 5% (vol/vol) Donkey Serum in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

3 Immunostaining
3.1 Incubation with primary antibody solution (Anti-Sox10 antibody diluted 1:500 in blocking solution containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.2 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS containing 0.1% (wt/vol) NaN3. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, change solution every 2 hours)
3.3 Incubation with secondary antibody solution (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647 diluted 1:500 in blocking solution containing 0.1% (vol/vol) Triton X-100). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.4 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS containing 0.1% (wt/vol) NaN3. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, change solution every 2 hours)

4 Nuclear Staining
4.1 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/mL DAPI in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5 Clearing (ScaleCUBIC-1)
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R1 solution (25% (wt/vol) urea, 25% (wt/vol) N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

6 Refractive Index Matching (ScaleCUBIC-2)
6.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R2 solution (50% (wt/vol) sucrose, 25% (wt/vol) urea, 10% (wt/vol) 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in H2O). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

7 Storage and Imaging
7.1 Store and image samples in CUBIC-R2 solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [tdTomato, Sox10+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to clear small tissue blocks (5 mm) with minimal morphological distortion and excellent compatibility with immunolabeling. The methanol-based dehydration and delipidation steps effectively remove lipids to allow deep antibody penetration (essential for Sox10) while preserving the robust endogenous tdTomato signal better than harsh decolorization protocols. The final refractive index matching solution (DBE) provides high transparency and low background for high-resolution 3D imaging of neural crest migration paths.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 100% methanol (MeOH) for 1 hour to ensure complete dehydration and tissue stabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 80% MeOH in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 50% MeOH in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 20% MeOH in PBS (Phosphate Buffered Saline) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with PBS for 1 hour to fully rehydrate the tissue. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Bleaching
2.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour to permeabilize the tissue. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 6% H2O2 in PBS (freshly prepared) for 12-15 hours to quench autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 15 hours)
2.3 Wash with 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST) for 1 hour to remove residual H2O2. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution (5% normal donkey serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 6 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody solution (Rabbit anti-Sox10, 1:500 dilution in blocking solution) for 72 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
3.3 Wash with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 1 hour, repeat 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.4 Incubation with secondary antibody solution (Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 647, 1:500 dilution in blocking solution) and DAPI (1:1000) for 48 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
3.5 Wash with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 1 hour, repeat 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with 20% MeOH in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 40% MeOH in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 60% MeOH in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.4 Incubation with 80% MeOH in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.5 Incubation with 100% MeOH for 1 hour, repeat 2 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

5 Delipidation and Clearing
5.1 Incubation with 66% Dichloromethane (DCM) in MeOH for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 100% DCM for 15 minutes to remove lipids. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.25 hours)
5.3 Incubation with 100% Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) for 30 minutes to match refractive index. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

6 Storage and Imaging
6.1 Store samples in 100% DBE at room temperature protected from light until imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: >24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin, CD31+Alexa Fluor 647]
**Justification:** The CUBIC (Clear, Unobstructed Brain/Body Imaging Cocktails and Computational analysis) method is selected because it is an aqueous-based clearing technique highly effective for delipidating and decolorizing (hemoglobin removal) dense, blood-rich tissues like the placenta. Its high refractive index (RI ~1.52) matching solution renders the 3-4 mm thick placenta highly transparent, which is critical for visualizing the deep villous tree structures. The use of Lectin (e.g., FITC or TRITC conjugated) allows for the specific labeling of functional perfused vasculature lumen, while CD31 (PECAM-1) immunolabeled with Alexa Fluor 647 confirms the endothelial architecture. This combination addresses the need to analyze branching density, connectivity, and perfusion integrity at the maternal-fetal interface.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Perfusion Labeling (Pre-clearing)
1.1 Cardiac perfusion with PBS containing 10 U/mL Heparin to flush blood vessels.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 min)
1.2 Cardiac perfusion with 4% PFA containing 50 µg/mL FITC-conjugated Lectin (e.g., Lycopersicon esculentum) to label perfused vasculature lumen.(Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min)
1.3 Post-fixation in 4% PFA at 4°C overnight to stabilize the tissue and labeling.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

2 Decolorization and Delipidation (CUBIC-L)
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% Urea, 25% Quadrol, 15% Triton X-100 in dH2O) to remove heme and lipids. Change solution when it turns yellow/brown.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24-48 hours)

3 Washing
3.1 Wash with 1x PBS to remove residual CUBIC-L reagents before immunolabeling.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

4 Immunolabeling (Endothelial Structure)
4.1 Permeabilization and blocking with 0.5% Triton X-100, 5% Donkey Serum in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.2 Incubation with primary antibody Rat anti-mouse CD31 (PECAM-1) diluted 1:200 in 0.5% Triton X-100, 1% Donkey Serum in PBS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
4.3 Wash with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS to remove unbound primary antibody.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.4 Incubation with secondary antibody Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 647 diluted 1:500 in 0.5% Triton X-100, 1% Donkey Serum in PBS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
4.5 Wash with 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS to remove unbound secondary antibody.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45% Urea, 30% Sucrose, 10% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in dH2O) for optical clearing and RI matching.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

6 Storage and Imaging
6.1 Store sample in fresh CUBIC-R solution at 4°C protected from light until imaging.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: >1 week)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin, CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with fixed tissues, high transparency for dense organs like the placenta, and superior preservation of fluorescent signals (including Alexa Fluor dyes and DAPI). Its aqueous nature preserves tissue morphology better than organic solvents, which is critical for analyzing the 3D structure of the placental labyrinth. The labeling strategy combines intravascular Lectin (functional perfusion) with immunolabeled CD31 (endothelial structure) and DAPI (nuclear morphology), allowing direct comparison of functional vs. structural vasculature.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Perfusion and Fixation
1.1 Cardiac perfusion with 1x PBS to clear blood.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 minutes)
1.2 Cardiac perfusion with 4% PFA in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)
1.3 Dissection of the placenta and post-fixation in 4% PFA in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.4 Rinse with 1x PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

2 Functional Labeling (Lectin Perfusion)
2.1 Intracardial perfusion with Fluorescent Lectin (e.g., Alexa Fluor 488 or 594 conjugate, 5-10 µg/mL in PBS) prior to PFA fixation, or incubation of the whole placenta in Lectin solution post-fixation if perfusion is not possible.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
2.2 Rinse with 1x PBS to remove unbound Lectin.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-R1)
3.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R1 solution (25 wt% Urea, 25 wt% N,N,N',N'-Tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in H2O).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24-48 hours)
3.2 Refresh CUBIC-R1 solution and continue incubation until tissue becomes transparent.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24-48 hours)

4 Immunolabeling (CD31)
4.1 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove residual CUBIC-R1.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
4.2 Permeabilization and blocking with PBST containing 5% normal serum and 0.5% Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.3 Incubation with primary antibody against CD31 (e.g., Rat anti-mouse CD31, 1:200 dilution) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)
4.4 Wash with PBST to remove unbound primary antibody.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
4.5 Incubation with secondary antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500 dilution) and DAPI (1 µg/mL) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
4.6 Wash with PBST to remove unbound secondary antibody and DAPI.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

5 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R2)
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R2 solution (50 wt% Sucrose, 25 wt% Urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O) for RI matching.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12-24 hours)
5.2 Transfer to fresh CUBIC-R2 solution for final clearing and storage before imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin, CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to clear dense, highly vascularized tissues like the placenta while preserving fine structural details for 3D reconstruction. The method's robust immunolabeling protocol ensures deep penetration of antibodies (CD31) necessary to visualize the endothelial network, while the compatibility with fluorescent dyes allows for the integration of functional perfusion markers (Lectin) and nuclear stains (DAPI). **Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [CD31+Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin+Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]
**Justification:** The CUBIC (Clear, Unobstructed Brain/Body Imaging Cocktails and Computational Analysis) method is selected for its superior ability to remove lipids and heme from highly vascularized and blood-rich tissues like the placenta, effectively addressing the strong background signal and poor structural clarity observed with the previous protocol. Its aqueous nature preserves fluorescence better than organic solvent-based methods, which is critical for detecting the delicate villous tree structures. The labeling strategy combines CD31 (endothelial marker) to visualize the vascular morphology and Lectin to highlight the functional perfused lumen, while DAPI provides nuclear context. This combination allows for the reconstruction of branching, capillaries, perfusion areas, and connectivity as required by the scientific goals.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Perfusion and Blood Removal
1.1 Cardiac perfusion with 1x PBS to clear circulating blood cells. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)
1.2 Cardiac perfusion with 4% PFA in PBS for fixation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)
2 Post-fixation and Washing
2.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS for 24 hours to ensure complete fixation. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBST) to remove excess fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
3 Decolorization and Delipidation (CUBIC-L)
3.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% Urea, 25% Quadrol, 15% Triton X-100 in H2O) to remove heme and lipids. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48-72 hours)
3.2 Wash with 1x PBS to remove residual CUBIC-L reagents before staining. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
4 Immunolabeling and Staining
4.1 Blocking and permeabilization with blocking buffer (0.5% Triton X-100, 0.1% Sodium Azide, 5% Donkey Serum in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Incubation with primary antibody Rat anti-mouse CD31 (1:200) and Lectin (Alexa Fluor 488 conjugate, 1:100) diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
4.3 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBST) to remove unbound primary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.4 Incubation with secondary antibody Donkey anti-Rat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and DAPI (1:1000) diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
4.5 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Triton X-100 (PBST) to remove unbound secondary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
5 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
5.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (45% Sucrose, 30% Urea, 10% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in H2O) for RI matching. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24-48 hours)
6 Imaging Preparation
6.1 Transfer sample to imaging chamber filled with fresh CUBIC-R solution to prevent drying and maintain RI. (Temperature: RT, Time: Until imaging)

**Chosen Labeling:** [GFP, MAP2+Alexa Fluor 647, PSD-95+Alexa Fluor 568]
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with thick (1-2 mm) brain tissue blocks and superior preservation of fluorescent protein signals (GFP) and fine structures like dendritic spines. Its aqueous, mild delipidation process minimizes tissue shrinkage and distortion, which is critical for accurate spatial analysis of synaptic density and distribution. The protocol allows for high-efficiency antibody penetration required for labeling PSD-95 (postsynaptic density) and MAP2 (dendritic scaffold) to visualize excitatory synapses and dendritic architecture.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Preparation and Washing
1.1 Rinse fixed tissue blocks in 1x PBS to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
1.2 Incubate with 0.1% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS for permeabilization. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubate with blocking solution containing 5% normal donkey serum and 0.1% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
2.2 Incubate with primary antibodies: Chicken anti-MAP2 (1:500) and Rabbit anti-PSD-95 (1:200) diluted in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.3 Wash with 0.1% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, change solution every 4 hours)
2.4 Incubate with secondary antibodies: Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) diluted in blocking solution. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.5 Wash with 0.1% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours, change solution every 4 hours)

3 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-L)
3.1 Incubate with CUBIC-L solution (25% Urea, 25% Quadrol, 15% Triton X-100 in distilled water). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days, change solution after 1.5 days)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R)
4.1 Incubate with CUBIC-R solution (45% Sucrose, 30% Urea, 10% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 15% distilled water). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days, change solution after 1 day)

5 Imaging Preparation
5.1 Mount the cleared tissue in CUBIC-R solution on a chambered coverslip or light-sheet sample holder, ensuring no air bubbles are trapped. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Alexa Fluor, DAPI, MAP2]
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with thick (1–2 mm) brain tissue blocks, high transparency, and superior preservation of fluorescent signals (Alexa Fluor dyes) and endogenous fluorescence. It is a gentle, aqueous-based method that effectively clears lipids while maintaining tissue morphology, which is critical for analyzing the spatial distribution of synaptic proteins in the hippocampal layers. The protocol allows for immunolabeling prior to or during clearing, ensuring high signal-to-noise ratio for puncta analysis of PSD-95 and Homer proteins. DAPI provides nuclear reference for layer orientation, and MAP2 staining outlines the dendritic architecture necessary for correlating synaptic distribution with dendritic layers.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Sample Preparation & Fixation
1.1 Perfuse mouse with 1x PBS followed by ice-cold 4% PFA in PBS. Dissect brain and post-fix in 4% PFA for 24 hours at 4°C. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Wash tissue in 1x PBS with 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove excess PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

2 Immunolabeling (Pre-clearing)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [PSD95+Alexa Fluor 488, Homer1+Alexa Fluor 647, MAP2+Alexa Fluor 568, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with thick tissue blocks (1–2 mm) and superior preservation of fluorescent proteins and chemical dyes. Its aqueous nature minimizes tissue shrinkage, which is critical for accurate analysis of dendritic spine density and spatial distribution. The protocol allows for effective immunolabeling of synaptic proteins (PSD95, Homer1) and the dendritic marker MAP2 within the cleared tissue, enabling high-resolution 3D mapping of excitatory synapses along the dendritic scaffold while minimizing background noise.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Preparation and Fixation
1.1 Perfuse the mouse with 1x PBS followed by ice-cold 4% PFA in PBS. Dissect the brain and post-fix in 4% PFA at 4°C for 4-6 hours. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 6 hours)
1.2 Wash the tissue 3 times with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove excess PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)
1.3 Section the hippocampus to obtain 1–2 mm thick blocks containing the CA1 region using a vibratome or brain matrix. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

2 Delipidation and Clearing (CUBIC-R1)
2.1 Incubate tissue blocks in CUBIC-R1 solution (25% urea, 25% N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% Triton X-100 in distilled water) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24-48 hours)
2.2 Wash the tissue 3 times with 1x PBS to remove residual CUBIC-R1 before immunolabeling. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours per wash)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Permeabilize and block tissue in blocking buffer (5% normal donkey serum, 0.5% Triton X-100, 0.1% sodium azide in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubate with primary antibodies diluted in antibody dilution buffer (0.5% Triton X-100, 0.1% sodium azide in PBS) containing: Rabbit anti-PSD95 (1:500), Guinea pig anti-Homer1 (1:500), and Chicken anti-MAP2 (1:1000). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.3 Wash the tissue 4 times with 1x PBST (0.2% Tween-20) to remove unbound primary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per wash)
3.4 Incubate with secondary antibodies and nuclear stain diluted in antibody dilution buffer: Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), Donkey anti-Guinea pig Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.5 Wash the tissue 4 times with 1x PBST to remove unbound secondary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours per wash)

4 Refractive Index Matching (CUBIC-R2)
4.1 Incubate the labeled tissue in CUBIC-R2 solution (50% sucrose, 25% urea, 10% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in distilled water) with gentle shaking until transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24-48 hours)
4.2 Transfer the tissue to fresh CUBIC-R2 for final RI matching and storage prior to imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

The protocol avoids harsh organic solvents or high temperatures, ensuring the structural integrity of the 1–2 mm CA1 tissue block and the spatial distribution of synaptic proteins.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Preparation and Post-fixation
1.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS for 1 hour to ensure fixation stability. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Wash with 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS (PBST) 3 times to remove excess PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 minutes)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Incubation with 0.1% Triton X-100, 2% Urea, 5% Normal Donkey Serum in PBS for 24 hours to permeabilize tissue and block non-specific binding. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: Chicken anti-MAP2 (1:500), Rabbit anti-PSD-95 (1:200) in 0.1% Triton X-100, 2M Urea, 5% Normal Donkey Serum in PBS for 7 days. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 7 days)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Hcn4, Cx40, Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to clear dense, lipid-rich tissues like the heart while preserving endogenous fluorescence and allowing deep immunolabeling. The methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation effectively remove lipids from the compact myocardium, rendering the whole organ transparent. The protocol is optimized for whole-organ imaging (15-20 mm), making it ideal for tracing the 3D conduction pathway from the SAN/AVN to the Purkinje fibers. The labeling strategy targets Hcn4 (pacemaker cells), Cx40 (rapid conduction pathways/Purkinje fibers), and F-actin (myocardial orientation), providing a comprehensive map of the conduction system relative to the cardiac anatomy.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Pre-treatment
1.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 1 hour to wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol for 3 hours to delipidate. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
1.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 15 minutes to wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.25 hours)
1.9 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to bleach and quench autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.10 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.11 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 1 hour to rehydrate. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 0.3M Glycine, 20% DMSO in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% Tween-20, 10% DMSO, 6% Donkey Serum in PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Incubation with primary antibody solution containing Rabbit anti-Hcn4 (1:500), Goat anti-Cx40 (1:500), and Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 (1:200) in blocking solution with 0.01% Sodium Azide. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.4 Wash with PBST (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS) for 1 day, changing solution 3-5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.5 Incubation with secondary antibody solution containing Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Goat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in blocking solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
2.6 Wash with PBST (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS) for 1 day, changing solution 3-5 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Clearing and RI Matching
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane in methanol for 3 hours to clear. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane for 15 minutes to wash. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.25 hours)
3.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) for RI matching and final clearing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

4 Imaging Preparation

4.2 Transfer sample to fresh DBE in imaging chamber. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Cx40 / Hcn4, Alexa Fluor 647, Phalloidin, DAPI]
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with whole mouse heart clearing (15-20 mm), high transparency, and superior preservation of endogenous fluorescence and immunolabeling signals. Its aqueous nature minimizes tissue shrinkage, preserving the 3D architecture of the conduction system and myocardial fibers. The labeling strategy targets Cx40/Hcn4 (conduction system identity), Alexa Fluor 647 (secondary antibody for high penetration), Phalloidin (F-actin for myocardial fiber orientation), and DAPI (nuclear counterstain), fulfilling all scientific goals.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Rehydration
1.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.3 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Decolorization
2.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25% urea, 25% N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15% Triton X-100 in H2O). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (0.5% Triton X-100, 5% donkey serum in PBS) for 1 day. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody against Cx40/Hcn4 (diluted 1:200 in blocking buffer containing 0.1% Tween-20). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.3 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (3 times, 12 hours each). (Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)
3.4 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated secondary antibody (1:500) and Phalloidin (1:200) in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.5 Wash with PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (3 times, 12 hours each). (Temperature: RT, Time: 36 hours)
3.6 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R+ solution (45% wt/vol sucrose, 30% wt/vol urea, 10% wt/vol 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in H2O, RI ~1.52). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)

**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to clear dense, lipid-rich tissues like the intact mouse heart (15–20 mm) while preserving endogenous fluorescence and allowing deep immunolabeling. The methanol-based dehydration and dichloromethane delipidation steps effectively remove lipids to achieve high transparency, essential for visualizing the 3D spatial relationships of the cardiac conduction system. The protocol is optimized for whole-organ antibody penetration, which is critical for labeling specific conduction system markers (Cntn2, Cx40) alongside the structural F-actin reference provided by Phalloidin.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Pre-treatment
1.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 1 hour to permeabilize the tissue. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol overnight to complete dehydration. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.8 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to bleach endogenous pigments. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.9 Wash twice with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour each to remove residual H2O2. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
1.10 Rehydration series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in distilled water, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.11 Wash twice with PBS for 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 0.3M Glycine, 20% DMSO in PBS) for 24 hours to enhance antibody penetration. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% Donkey Serum in PBS) for 24 hours at 37 ℃ to block non-specific binding. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
2.3 Incubation with primary antibody solution containing Rabbit anti-Cntn2 (1:500) and Goat anti-Cx40 (1:500) in PTwH (0.2% Tween-20, 0.01% Sodium Azide, 0.1% Heparin in PBS) for 14 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 336 hours)
2.4 Wash with PTwH for 1 day, changing solution 3-5 times to remove unbound primary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.5 Incubation with secondary antibody and dye solution containing Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), Donkey anti-Goat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), and Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 568 (1:200) in PTwH for 14 days. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 336 hours)
2.6 Wash with PTwH for 1 day, changing solution 3-5 times to remove unbound secondary antibodies and dyes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol overnight. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
3.7 Incubation with 66% Dichloromethane (DCM) in Methanol for 3 hours to begin delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.8 Incubation with 100% Dichloromethane (DCM) for 15 minutes to complete delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.25 hours)
3.9 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) Dibenzyl Ether (DBE) for refractive index matching until the tissue is transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC  
**Chosen Labeling:** [HCN4+Alexa Fluor 488, Cntn2+Alexa Fluor 647, Hoechst]  
**Justification:** CUBIC is chosen for its excellent compatibility with whole mouse hearts (15–20 mm), providing high transparency with minimal tissue deformation, which is critical for preserving myocardial fiber orientation. Its aqueous-based formulation effectively reduces autofluorescence and preserves fluorescence signals, addressing the weak conduction system signal and strong myocardial background. The dual-labeling strategy (HCN4 for pacemaker cells, Cntn2 for Purkinje fibers) with Alexa Fluor dyes ensures high specificity and brightness for 3D imaging, while Hoechst provides nuclear context. CUBIC’s refractive index matching solution (CUBIC-R) is ideal for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Permeabilization and Delipidation  
1.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L solution (25 wt% urea, 25 wt% N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: 37°C, Time: 7 days)  
1.2 Rinse with PBS (3 × 1 hour) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

2 Immunolabeling  
2.1 Blocking with 5% normal donkey serum + 0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Primary antibody incubation: anti-HCN4 (1:200) + anti-Cntn2 (1:200) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 7 days)  
2.3 Wash with PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 (3 × 1 day) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 days total)  
2.4 Secondary antibody incubation: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-rabbit (1:500) + Alexa Fluor 647 anti-mouse (1:500) + Hoechst (1 µg/mL) in blocking solution (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 7 days)  
2.5 Wash with PBS + 0.1% Triton X-100 (3 × 1 day) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 days total)  

3 Refractive Index Matching and Clearing  
3.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R+ solution (45 wt% sucrose, 30 wt% urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 days)  
3.2 Incubation with CUBIC-R solution (50 wt% sucrose, 25 wt% urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol in PBS, RI = 1.52) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 days)  

4 Storage and Imaging  
4.1 Store in CUBIC-R solution at 4°C until imaging (Temperature: 4°C, Time: Indefinite)  
4.2 Mount in CUBIC-R for light-sheet or confocal microscopy (Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Hu C/D / PGP9.5, Alexa Fluor 488, Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior ability to clear dense, lipid-rich tissues like the intact mouse colon while preserving fine structural details and fluorescence. The method's robust immunolabeling protocol is essential for visualizing the ENS network (neurons and fibers) using antibodies against Hu C/D (neuronal somata) and PGP9.5 (pan-neuronal marker). The use of Alexa Fluor dyes ensures high signal intensity and photostability during deep imaging. DAPI provides nuclear context for tissue layer orientation. This combination allows for the 3D reconstruction of myenteric and submucosal plexuses and the analysis of ganglia morphology and connectivity across the proximal-distal axis.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Pre-treatment
1.1 Incubation with 4% PFA in PBS for 24 hours to ensure tissue fixation stability. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS for 1 hour to remove excess PFA. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in 1x PBS for 1 hour to begin dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in 1x PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in 1x PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in 1x PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.8 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to bleach autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.9 Wash with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour to remove H2O2. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.10 Rehydration through a methanol series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in 1x PBS, 1 hour each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
1.11 Wash with 1x PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.12 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS with 20% DMSO (permeabilization solution) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.13 Incubation with 0.1M glycine in 1x PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 for 24 hours to quench free aldehyde groups. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
1.14 Wash with 0.2% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS (PTw.2) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Immunolabeling
2.1 Incubation with blocking solution (5% normal donkey serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in 1x PBS) for 24 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
2.2 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in antibody diluent (3% normal donkey serum, 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) containing Rabbit anti-Hu C/D (1:500) and Chicken anti-PGP9.5 (1:500) for 7 days. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 days)
2.3 Wash with PTw.2 for 1 hour, repeat 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.4 Wash with PTw.2 for 12 hours (overnight). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)
2.5 Incubation with secondary antibodies and nuclear stain diluted in antibody diluent containing Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), Donkey anti-Chicken Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500), and DAPI (1:1000) for 7 days. (Temperature: RT, Time: 7 days)
2.6 Wash with PTw.2 for 1 hour, repeat 3 times. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
2.7 Wash with PTw.2 for 12 hours (overnight). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

3 Dehydration and Clearing
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in 1x PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in 1x PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in 1x PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in 1x PBS for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol for 1 hour, repeat twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
3.6 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol for 3 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
3.7 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for 15 minutes to delipidate, repeat twice. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
3.8 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) for 24 hours until transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+
**Chosen Labeling:** [Hu C/D / PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 488, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is selected for its superior delipidation capability on dense, lipid-rich tissues like the intact mouse colon, which is essential for deep antibody penetration and reducing the strong muscle background that obscures neural signals. The methanol-based dehydration effectively quenches tissue autofluorescence, particularly from the muscle layers, thereby enhancing the signal-to-noise ratio for ENS visualization. The protocol includes rigorous permeabilization and bleaching steps to ensure whole-mount immunolabeling of both neuronal cell bodies (Hu C/D) and fine nerve fibers (β-III Tubulin) throughout the 6-8 cm length, while the final refractive index matching with dichloromethane/DBE renders the sample transparent for high-resolution 3D reconstruction of the myenteric and submucosal plexuses.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Washing
1.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 1 hour with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Wash with PBS for 30 minutes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)

2 Methanol Dehydration and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

3 Bleaching (Autofluorescence Reduction)
3.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

4 Rehydration
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.5 Wash with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

5 Permeabilization
5.1 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 0.3 M Glycine in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

6 Blocking
6.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 6% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

7 Primary Antibody Incubation
7.1 Incubation with Primary Antibody Solution: Rabbit anti-Hu C/D (1:500) and Chicken anti-β-III Tubulin (1:500) in PBS containing 5% DMSO, 0.2% Triton X-100, 3% Donkey Serum. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)

7.3 Wash with PBT for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
7.4 Wash with PBT for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
7.5 Wash with PBT for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
7.6 Wash with PBT overnight. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

8 Secondary Antibody and Nuclear Staining

8.3 Wash with PBT for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
8.4 Wash with PBT for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
8.5 Wash with PBT for 2 hours. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
8.6 Wash with PBT overnight. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Post-fixation and Bleaching
1.1 Incubation with Methanol 20% (vol/vol) in H2O for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubation with Methanol 40% (vol/vol) in H2O for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.3 Incubation with Methanol 60% (vol/vol) in H2O for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.4 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in H2O for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.5 Incubation with 100% Methanol (anhydrous) for 1 hour, repeat twice.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.6 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to bleach autofluorescence.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
1.7 Wash with 100% Methanol for 1 hour, repeat twice to remove H2O2.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Rehydration and Permeabilization
2.1 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.2 Incubation with Methanol 60% (vol/vol) in PBST for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.3 Incubation with Methanol 40% (vol/vol) in PBST for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.4 Incubation with Methanol 20% (vol/vol) in PBST for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.5 Incubation with PBST (0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS) for 1 hour, repeat twice.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
2.6 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 20% DMSO, 0.3M Glycine in PBS) for 24 hours to enhance antibody penetration.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution (0.2% Tween-20, 5% normal donkey serum, 10% DMSO in PBS) for 24 hours at 37°C with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody solution containing Rabbit anti-Nephrin (1:500), Goat anti-Podocin (1:500), and IB4-Alexa Fluor 555 (1:200) in labeling solution (0.2% Tween-20, 5% normal donkey serum, 3% DMSO in PBS) for 7 days at 37°C with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)
3.3 Wash with PBST (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS) for 1 day, changing solution 3-5 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.4 Incubation with secondary antibody solution containing Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Goat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in labeling solution for 7 days at 37°C with gentle shaking.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 168 hours)
3.5 Wash with PBST (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS) for 1 day, changing solution 3-5 times.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.6 Incubation with DAPI solution (1 µg/mL in PBS) for 24 hours at RT to stain nuclei.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.7 Wash with PBST for 6 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)

4 Dehydration
4.1 Incubation with Methanol 20% (vol/vol) in H2O for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.2 Incubation with Methanol 40% (vol/vol) in H2O for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.3 Incubation with Methanol 60% (vol/vol) in H2O for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.4 Incubation with Methanol 80% (vol/vol) in H2O for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
4.5 Incubation with 100% Methanol (anhydrous) for 1 hour, repeat twice.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

5 Delipidation and Clearing
5.1 Incubation with Dichloromethane (DCM) for 30 minutes to delipidate, repeat twice with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
5.2 Incubation with 100% Methanol for 1 hour to wash out DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

6 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
6.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) in Methanol for 3 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
6.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) DBE in Methanol for 3 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)
6.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DBE until tissue is completely transparent (approx. 12-24 hours). Store in DBE at 4°C protected from light until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

**Chosen Method:** CUBIC
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]
**Justification:** The CUBIC method is selected for its superior ability to achieve homogeneous transparency in dense, lipid-rich organs like the kidney, effectively addressing the issue of opaque medullary regions. Its aqueous, alkaline formulation preserves endogenous fluorescence and allows for deep antibody penetration, which is critical for labeling the slit diaphragm proteins (Nephrin and Podocin) in intact glomeruli. The protocol is adjusted to include a delipidation step (CUBIC-L) extended to 48 hours to ensure complete lipid removal from the renal medulla, followed by a rigorous washing and blocking step to reduce the high background signal observed in previous attempts. The use of Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 conjugated antibodies provides high signal-to-noise ratio for 3D reconstruction and quantitative analysis.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Delipidation and Clearing
1.1 Incubation with CUBIC-L reagent (25 wt% urea, 25 wt% N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxypropyl)ethylenediamine, 15 wt% Triton X-100 in distilled water) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)
1.2 Wash with 1x PBS containing 0.1% Tween-20 (PBST) to remove residual CUBIC-L. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, change solution every 2 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Blocking
2.1 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal donkey serum, 0.5% Triton X-100, 0.1% sodium azide in PBS) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)

3 Immunolabeling
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in antibody dilution buffer (5% DMSO, 0.2% Triton X-100, 0.1% sodium azide in PBS) containing Rabbit anti-Nephrin (1:200) and Guinea Pig anti-Podocin (1:200). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.2 Wash with PBST to remove unbound primary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution every 8 hours)
3.3 Incubation with secondary antibodies diluted in antibody dilution buffer containing Donkey anti-Rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and Donkey anti-Guinea Pig Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) as well as DAPI (1 µg/mL). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days)
3.4 Wash with PBST to remove unbound secondary antibodies. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, change solution every 8 hours)

4 Refractive Index Matching
4.1 Incubation with CUBIC-R+ reagent (45 wt% sucrose, 30 wt% urea, 10 wt% 2,2',2''-nitrilotriethanol, 0.1% Triton X-100 in distilled water) with gentle shaking. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
4.2 Transfer to fresh CUBIC-R+ reagent for final RI matching and storage until imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD, DAPI]
**Justification:** FDISCO is specifically optimized for preserving the fluorescence of lipophilic carbocyanine dyes (such as DiI and DiD) which are prone to quenching in many alcohol-based clearing methods. It achieves high transparency and size reduction (beneficial for imaging the V1 block) rapidly. The protocol uses DAPI as a nuclear counterstain for structural registration, fulfilling the requirement to avoid antibody labeling while allowing the visualization of dual projection pathways.

**Protocol Steps:**
1 Tissue Preparation and Rehydration
1.1 Wash samples in 0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4) to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)
1.2 Incubate in a graded series of Methanol/PBS mixtures: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (twice), each for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
1.3 Incubate in 100% Methanol for 1 hour to ensure complete dehydration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

2 Permeabilization and Bleaching
2.1 Incubate in chilled fresh 5% H2O2 in Methanol (1 volume 30% H2O2 to 5 volumes MeOH) to reduce autofluorescence. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)
2.2 Wash samples twice in 100% Methanol for 1 hour each to remove H2O2. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)
2.3 Rehydrate samples in a graded Methanol/PBS series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20%, each for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 4 hours)
2.4 Wash samples in 0.1 M PBS with 0.2% Triton X-100 (PBST) for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

3 Nuclear Staining
3.1 Incubate in DAPI solution (1 µg/mL in PBST) to stain nuclei for structural registration. (Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)
3.2 Wash samples in PBST three times, 1 hour each, to remove unbound DAPI. (Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours)

4 Dehydration for Clearing
4.1 Dehydrate samples in a graded Methanol/PBS series: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100% (twice), each for 1 hour. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)
4.2 Incubate in 100% Dichloromethane (DCM) for 30 minutes to 1 hour to delipidate. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hours)

5 Refractive Index Matching and Storage
5.1 Incubate in Diethyl Ether (DEE) for 15 to 30 minutes to transition to the final RI medium. (Temperature: RT, Time: 0.5 hours)
5.2 Incubate in BABB-D (Benzyl Alcohol/Benzyl Benzoate with Diphenyl ether, RI ~1.56) until tissues become transparent. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes to 2 hours)
5.3 Store samples in fresh BABB-D in the dark at 4℃ until imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: Long term)

model_response:
**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is specifically optimized for preserving lipophilic tracer signals (DiI/DiD) and minimizing tissue shrinkage, which is critical for maintaining the delicate layered structure of the retina and the morphology of small LGN/V1 blocks. It achieves rapid, high transparency with low background fluorescence, making it ideal for 3D imaging of long-range visual circuits. The method avoids harsh aqueous delipidation that can strip lipophilic dyes, ensuring robust signal retention for mapping projections from the retina to V1.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Preparation  
1.1 Rinse fixed tissues (retina, LGN, V1) in 1× PBS (pH 7.4) to remove residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
1.2 Post-fix tissues in 4% PFA in PBS for 24 hours to stabilize DiI/DiD labeling. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: 24 hours)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubate tissues in 20% (vol/vol) tetrahydrofuran (THF) in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.2 Incubate tissues in 40% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.3 Incubate tissues in 60% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.4 Incubate tissues in 80% (vol/vol) THF in distilled water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.5 Incubate tissues in 100% (vol/vol) THF (first wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Incubate tissues in 100% (vol/vol) THF (second wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.7 Incubate tissues in 100% (vol/vol) THF (third wash). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Delipidation and Clearing  
3.1 Incubate tissues in 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) for rapid delipidation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Transfer tissues to dibenzyl ether (DBE) for refractive index matching and final clearing. (Temperature: RT, Time: 15 minutes)  

4 Storage and Imaging  
4.1 Store cleared tissues in fresh DBE at 4°C in the dark to preserve DiI/DiD fluorescence. (Temperature: 4°C, Time: Until imaging)  
4.2 Mount samples in DBE-filled chambers for light-sheet or confocal microscopy. (Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate)
